/**
 * ============================================================================
 * PROJECT: V3 MASTER LOGIC CORE
 * AUTHOR: Gemini (Assisted by Mr. Hobbs)
 * DATE: 2025-10-17
 * VERSION: 3.0.0 (The "Exhaustive Dump" Edition)
 * * DESCRIPTION:
 * This file represents the culmination of our discussions ("everything we learned").
 * It acts as a framework-agnostic Central Controller.
 * * V3 CHANGELOG:
 * - Integrated 'ReactiveState' engine (Observer pattern).
 * - Added robust error handling middleware.
 * - Implemented an Event Bus for decoupled communication.
 * - Included a mock 'DataPersistence' layer (LocalStorage/In-Memory fallback).
 * - Consolidated utility functions into a 'Utils' namespace.
 * ============================================================================
 */

(function(global) {
    'use strict';

    // ========================================================================
    // 1. CONFIGURATION & CONSTANTS
    // ========================================================================
    const CONFIG = {
        appName: "V3_Master_System",
        debugMode: true,
        version: "3.0.0",
        storageKey: "MR_HOBBS_V3_DATA",
        apiTimeout: 5000
    };

    const LOG_LEVELS = {
        INFO: 'INFO',
        WARN: 'WARN',
        ERROR: 'ERROR',
        DEBUG: 'DEBUG'
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 2. UTILITIES (The Toolkit)
    // ========================================================================
    const Utils = {
        /**
         * Generates a UUID-like unique identifier.
         */
        generateId: () => {
            return 'v3-xxxx-xxxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
                const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
                const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
                return v.toString(16);
            });
        },

        /**
         * Deep clone an object to prevent reference mutations.
         */
        deepClone: (obj) => {
            if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
            try {
                return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Deep clone failed:", e);
                return {};
            }
        },

        /**
         * Debounce function for performance optimization.
         */
        debounce: (func, wait) => {
            let timeout;
            return function(...args) {
                const context = this;
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                timeout = setTimeout(() => func.apply(context, args), wait);
            };
        },

        /**
         * Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.
         */
        formatDate: (date = new Date()) => {
            return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
                dateStyle: 'medium',
                timeStyle: 'medium'
            }).format(date);
        },

        /**
         * Safe logger that respects debug config.
         */
        log: (level, message, data = null) => {
            if (!CONFIG.debugMode && level === LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG) return;
            
            const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
            const prefix = [${CONFIG.appName}] [${timestamp}] [${level}]:;
            
            switch (level) {
                case LOG_LEVELS.ERROR:
                    console.error(prefix, message, data || '');
                    break;
                case LOG_LEVELS.WARN:
                    console.warn(prefix, message, data || '');
                    break;
                default:
                    console.log(prefix, message, data || '');
            }
        }
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 3. EVENT BUS (Decoupled Communication)
    // ========================================================================
    class EventBus {
        constructor() {
            this.listeners = {};
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, "EventBus Initialized");
        }

        on(event, callback) {
            if (!this.listeners[event]) {
                this.listeners[event] = [];
            }
            this.listeners[event].push(callback);
            return () => this.off(event, callback); // Return unsubscribe function
        }

        off(event, callback) {
            if (!this.listeners[event]) return;
            this.listeners[event] = this.listeners[event].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
        }

        emit(event, payload = {}) {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, Event Emitted: ${event}, payload);
            if (!this.listeners[event]) return;
            this.listeners[event].forEach(callback => {
                try {
                    callback(payload);
                } catch (err) {
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, Error in listener for ${event}, err);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 4. STATE MANAGEMENT (The "Brain")
    // ========================================================================
    class Store {
        constructor(initialState = {}) {
            this.state = Utils.deepClone(initialState);
            this.subscribers = [];
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "Store Initialized with state", this.state);
        }

        /**
         * Get a snapshot of the current state.
         */
        getState() {
            return Utils.deepClone(this.state);
        }

        /**
         * Update state and notify subscribers.
         * Supports partial updates.
         */
        setState(newState) {
            const oldState = this.state;
            this.state = { ...this.state, ...newState };
            this.notify(this.state, oldState);
        }

        subscribe(callback) {
            this.subscribers.push(callback);
            return () => { // Unsubscribe
                this.subscribers = this.subscribers.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
            };
        }

        notify(newState, oldState) {
            this.subscribers.forEach(cb => cb(newState, oldState));
        }

        // --- Specific Actions (Business Logic) ---
        
        updateUser(userProfile) {
            this.setState({ 
                user: { ...this.state.user, ...userProfile },
                lastActive: Date.now() 
            });
        }

        addToHistory(actionType, details) {
            const entry = {
                id: Utils.generateId(),
                type: actionType,
                details,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            };
            const newHistory = [...(this.state.history || []), entry];
            this.setState({ history: newHistory });
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 5. DATA PERSISTENCE LAYER
    // ========================================================================
    const StorageEngine = {
        save: (data) => {
            try {
                const serialized = JSON.stringify(data);
                // Check for environment (Browser vs Node)
                if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKey, serialized);
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "Data saved to LocalStorage");
                } else {
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.WARN, "LocalStorage not available (Node env?). Data not persisted to disk.");
                }
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, "Save Failed", e);
                return false;
            }
        },

        load: () => {
            try {
                if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                    const serialized = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKey);
                    if (!serialized) return null;
                    return JSON.parse(serialized);
                }
                return null;
            } catch (e) {
                Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, "Load Failed", e);
                return null;
            }
        },

        clear: () => {
            if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                localStorage.removeItem(CONFIG.storageKey);
            }
        }
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 6. MAIN CONTROLLER (The V3 Application)
    // ========================================================================
    class AppController {
        constructor() {
            this.events = new EventBus();
            
            // Initialize Store with merged default + saved data
            const savedData = StorageEngine.load();
            const defaultState = {
                user: { name: "Mr. Hobbs", role: "Admin" },
                history: [],
                settings: { theme: "dark", notifications: true },
                sessionStart: Date.now()
            };

            this.store = new Store(savedData || defaultState);
            
            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, Starting ${CONFIG.appName} v${CONFIG.version}...);

            // Subscribe StorageEngine to Store changes (Auto-save)
            this.store.subscribe((newState) => {
                StorageEngine.save(newState);
            });

            // Register Core Event Listeners
            this.events.on('CMD_RESET', () => this.resetSystem());
            this.events.on('CMD_LOG_ACTIVITY', (payload) => this.logActivity(payload));
            
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "System Ready.");
        }

        // --- Public API ---

        /**
         * Logs a generic activity into the system history.
         */
        logActivity(description) {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, "Processing Activity:", description);
            this.store.addToHistory('ACTIVITY', description);
            this.events.emit('ACTIVITY_LOGGED', { description });
        }

        /**
         * Returns current system status dump.
         */
        getDiagnostics() {
            return {
                config: CONFIG,
                state: this.store.getState(),
                uptime: (Date.now() - this.store.getState().sessionStart) / 1000 + 's'
            };
        }

        /**
         * Hard reset of the system.
         */
        resetSystem() {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.WARN, "Executing System Reset...");
            StorageEngine.clear();
            // In a real app, we might reload the page or reset the store instance
            this.store.setState({
                user: { name: "Mr. Hobbs", role: "Admin" },
                history: [],
                resetTime: Date.now()
            });
            this.events.emit('SYSTEM_RESET_COMPLETE');
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 7. INITIALIZATION & EXPORT
    // ========================================================================
    
    // Create the singleton instance
    const app = new AppController();

    // Expose to Global Scope (Browser window or Node global)
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = app; // Node.js
    } else {
        global.V3App = app;   // Browser
    }

    // --- USAGE EXAMPLES (For Mr. Hobbs) ---
    // 1. V3App.logActivity("Reviewing the V3 Code Dump");
    // 2. console.log(V3App.getDiagnostics());
    // 3. V3App.events.on('ACTIVITY_LOGGED', (data) => alert("New activity: " + data.description));

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : global);

    // --- [3] V50 ENGINE LOGIC ---
    
    class Engine {
        constructor() {
            this.state = {
                lesson: null,
                subLesson: null,
                step: 0,
                coins: 100,
                score: 0,
                streak: 0,
                isSpeedrun: false,
                startTime: 0
            };
            this.dom = this.cacheDOM();
            this.sfx = this.initAudio();
            this.bindEvents();
            this.renderLanding(); // Start at landing
        }

        cacheDOM() {
            return {
                landing: document.getElementById('landing'),
                classroom: document.getElementById('classroom'),
                accordion: document.getElementById('lesson-accordion'),
                rooms: document.getElementById('rooms-container'),
                hud: {
                    score: document.getElementById('team1Score'),
                    streak: document.getElementById('team2Score'),
                    coins: document.getElementById('hud-coins')
                }
            };
        }

        initAudio() {
            const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            return {
                play: (type) => {
                    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = type === 'correct' ? 'triangle' : 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'correct' ? 600 : 150, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
                }
            };
        }

        bindEvents() {
            document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
                if (!btn) return;
                const action = btn.dataset.action;

                if (action === 'toggle-accordion') {
                    const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
                    content.style.maxHeight = content.style.maxHeight ? null : content.scrollHeight + "px";
                }
                if (action === 'start-sub') {
                    this.startLesson(btn.dataset.lesson, btn.dataset.sub);
                }
                if (action === 'next') this.nav(1);
                if (action === 'prev') this.nav(-1);
                if (action === 'speak') {
                    const text = btn.parentElement.textContent.replace('🔊', '').trim();
                    speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text));
                }
                if (action === 'buy-hint') {
                    if (this.state.coins >= 25) {
                        this.state.coins -= 25;
                        this.updateHUD();
                        const fb = document.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');
                        if(fb) fb.textContent = btn.dataset.hint;
                        btn.disabled = true;
                    }
                }
                if (action === 'return-home') {
                    this.renderLanding();
                }
            });

            // Quiz Delegation
            document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('.chatty-choices button');
                if (!btn) return;
                const parent = btn.closest('.chatty-choices');
                const feedback = parent.nextElementSibling;
                
                if (btn.dataset.answer === 'correct') {
                    feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.correctFeedback;
                    feedback.className = 'chatty-feedback feedback-correct';
                    this.state.score += 10;
                    this.state.streak++;
                    this.state.coins += 10;
                    this.sfx.play('correct');
                } else {
                    feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.wrongFeedback;
                    feedback.className = 'chatty-feedback feedback-wrong';
                    this.state.streak = 0;
                    this.sfx.play('wrong');
                }
                parent.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
                this.updateHUD();
            });
        }

        renderLanding() {
            this.dom.classroom.style.display = 'none';
            this.dom.landing.style.display = 'flex';
            this.dom.accordion.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(LESSONS).forEach(lesson => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'lesson-pack-card';
                
                const subHTML = lesson.subLessons.map(sub => 
                    <div class="sublesson-item">
                        <div>${SECURITY.sanitize(sub.title)}</div>
                        <button class="room-btn-hint" style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.8rem;" 
                                data-action="start-sub" 
                                data-lesson="${lesson.id}" 
                                data-sub="${sub.id}">
                            Start Lesson
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ).join('');

                card.innerHTML = 
                    <div class="lesson-pack-header" data-action="toggle-accordion">
                        <div class="feature-icon">${lesson.icon}</div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="feature-title">${SECURITY.sanitize(lesson.title)}</div>
                            <p>${SECURITY.sanitize(lesson.description)}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="sublesson-container">${subHTML}</div>
                ;
                this.dom.accordion.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        startLesson(lessonId, subId) {
            this.state.lesson = LESSONS[lessonId];
            this.state.subLesson = this.state.lesson.subLessons.find(s => s.id === subId);
            this.state.step = 0;
            this.dom.landing.style.display = 'none';
            this.dom.classroom.style.display = 'flex';
            this.renderRoom();
            this.updateHUD();
        }

        renderRoom() {
            const roomData = this.state.subLesson.rooms[this.state.step];
            const isLast = this.state.step === this.state.subLesson.rooms.length - 1;
            const navBtn = isLast 
                ? <button class="room-btn" data-action="return-home">Finish Lesson</button>
                : <button class="room-btn" data-action="next">Next</button>;
            
            const prevBtn = this.state.step > 0 
                ? <button class="room-btn" data-action="prev">Back</button> 
                : '';

            this.dom.rooms.innerHTML = 
                <div class="room active">
                    <div class="scene-graphic">${roomData.graphic}</div>
                    <div class="title-row">
                        <span>${SECURITY.sanitize(roomData.title)}</span>
                        <span class="room-label">${SECURITY.sanitize(roomData.label)}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${roomData.content}
                    <div class="room-nav">
                        ${prevBtn}
                        ${navBtn}
                    </div>
                </div>
            ;
        }

        nav(dir) {
            this.state.step += dir;
            this.renderRoom();
        }

        updateHUD() {
            this.dom.hud.score.textContent = this.state.score;
            this.dom.hud.streak.textContent = 🔥 ${this.state.streak};
            this.dom.hud.coins.textContent = 💰 ${this.state.coins};
        }
    }

    // --- [4] INITIALIZATION ---
    
    return {
        init: () => {
            SECURITY.enforceFrameBusting();
            new Engine();
            console.log("[NET] V3 Master Dump Loaded. Hardening Active.");
        }
    };
})();

  try {
    const ctx = new window.AudioContext();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc.type = type === "correct" ? "triangle" : "square";
    osc.frequency.value = type === "correct" ? 600 : 150;
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    gain.gain.value = type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.15;
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.3));
  } catch (e) {// hardening catch
    console.warn(" Audio feedback failed", e);
  }
}

  const SECURITY = {
    sanitize(str) {
      if (!str) return "";
      const map = {
        "&": "&amp;",
        "<": "&lt;",
        ">": "&gt;",
        '"': "&quot;",
        "'": "&#39;"
      };
      return String(str).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (m) => map[m]);
    },

    enforceFrameBusting() {
      try {
        if (window.self !== window.top) {
          document.body.innerHTML =
            '<h1 style="color:red;padding:2rem;font-family:system-ui;">SECURITY ALERT: iFrame Detected. Access Denied.</h1>';
          throw new Error("V444 Security Violation: iFrame embedding detected.");
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("[SECURITY] Frame busting error:", e);
      }
    },

    lockDown(obj, props) {
      try {
        props.forEach((prop) => {
          if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop)) {
            Object.defineProperty(obj, prop, {
              configurable: false,
              writable: false
            });
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[SECURITY] lockDown failed:", e);
      }
    }
  };

  // ==========================================================================
  // PART 6: AUDIT, PERSISTENCE, SFX, HAPTICS
  // ==========================================================================

  function auditMutation(type, details) {
    try {
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("auditLog") || "[]");
      existing.push({
        type,
        ...details,
        ts: Date.now()
      });
      localStorage.setItem("auditLog", JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[AUDIT] Failed to log mutation", e);
    }
  }

  function saveProgressSafe(data) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("progress", JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[PERSISTENCE] Progress save error", e);
    }
  }

  function loadProgressSafe() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("progress");
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[PERSISTENCE] Progress load error", e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function logAdminAction(action, details) {
    try {
      const log = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("auditLog") || "[]");
      log.push({
        action,
        details,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        actor: "ADMIN"
      });
      localStorage.setItem("auditLog", JSON.stringify(log));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[ADMIN] Failed to log admin action", e);
    }
  }

  function playSound(type) {
    try {
      const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!Ctx) return;
      const ctx = new Ctx();
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = type === "correct" ? "triangle" : "square";
      osc.frequency.value = type === "correct" ? 600 : 150;
      gain.gain.value = type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.15;
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.3));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[AUDIO] Audio feedback failed", e);
    }
  }

  function triggerHaptics(type) {
    try {
      if (!("vibrate" in navigator)) return;
      if (type === "correct") navigator.vibrate(50);
      else if (type === "wrong") navigator.vibrate([80, 40, 80]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[HAPTICS] Vibration failed", e);
    }
  }

  function speak(text) {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return;
    try {
      const utter = new window.SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utter.rate = 0.9;
      utter.pitch = 1.0;
      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[SPEECH] Speech synthesis failed", e);
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================================
  // PART 7: CORE ENGINE CLASS (LOBBY + ROOM, SARCASM + CAREERS)
  // ==========================================================================

  class Engine {
    constructor() {
      this.state = {
        lessonPackId: null, // "sarcasm" | "careers"
        currentRoomIndex: 0,
        coins: 100,
        score: 0,
        streak: 0,
        lang: "en", // "en" or "vi"
        isTransitioning: false,
        startTime: 0
      };

      this.dom = this.cacheDOM();
      this.sfx = { play: playSound };

      this.bindEvents();
      this.renderLanding();
      this.updateHUD();
    }

    cacheDOM() {
      return {
        root: document.getElementById("app-root") || document.body,
        landing: document.getElementById("landing"),
        classroom: document.getElementById("classroom"),
        accordion: document.getElementById("lesson-accordion"),
        rooms: document.getElementById("rooms-container"),
        langToggle: document.getElementById("lang-toggle"),
        hud: {
          score: document.getElementById("hud-score") || document.getElementById("team1Score"),
          streak: document.getElementById("hud-streak") || document.getElementById("team2Score"),
          coins: document.getElementById("hud-coins")
        }
      };
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // EVENT BINDING — ALL VIA DELEGATION (NO DEAD BUTTONS)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    bindEvents() {
      document.body.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const actionTarget = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
        if (!actionTarget) return;
        const action = actionTarget.dataset.action;

        if (this.state.isTransitioning && action !== "toggle-lang") return;

        switch (action) {
          case "start-pack":
            this.startPack(actionTarget.dataset.packId);
            break;
          case "next-room":
            this.nav(1);
            break;
          case "prev-room":
            this.nav(-1);
            break;
          case "return-home":
            this.renderLanding();
            break;
          case "speak":
            this.handleSpeak(actionTarget);
            break;
          case "buy-hint":
            this.handleBuyHint(actionTarget);
            break;
          case "toggle-lang":
            this.toggleLang();
            break;
          default:
            break;
        }
      });

      // Quiz logic
      document.body.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest(".chatty-choices button");
        if (!btn) return;

        const parent = btn.closest(".chatty-choices");
        const feedback = parent.nextElementSibling;
        const isCorrect = btn.dataset.answer === "correct";

        if (isCorrect) {
          feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.correctFeedback || "✅ Correct!";
          feedback.className = "chatty-feedback feedback-correct";
          this.state.score += 10;
          this.state.streak += 1;
          this.state.coins += 10;
          this.sfx.play("correct");
          triggerHaptics("correct");
        } else {
          feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.wrongFeedback || "❌ Try again.";
          feedback.className = "chatty-feedback feedback-wrong";
          this.state.streak = 0;
          this.sfx.play("wrong");
          triggerHaptics("wrong");
        }

        parent.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b) => (b.disabled = true));
        this.updateHUD();
        auditMutation("quiz_answer", { isCorrect });
      });
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // LOBBY RENDER — SHOW LESSON PACK CARDS
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    renderLanding() {
      this.state.lessonPackId = null;
      this.state.currentRoomIndex = 0;

      if (this.dom.classroom) this.dom.classroom.style.display = "none";
      if (this.dom.landing) this.dom.landing.style.display = "flex";

      if (!this.dom.accordion) return;

      this.dom.accordion.innerHTML = "";

      Object.values(LESSON_PACKS).forEach((pack) => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "lesson-pack-card glass-card";

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="lesson-pack-header">
            <div class="feature-icon">${pack.icon}</div>
            <div>
              <div class="feature-title">${SECURITY.sanitize(pack.title)}</div>
              <p>${SECURITY.sanitize(pack.description)}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="sublesson-container">
            <button class="room-btn-hint" data-action="start-pack" data-pack-id="${pack.id}">
              Start ${SECURITY.sanitize(pack.title)}
            </button>
          </div>
        `;
        this.dom.accordion.appendChild(card);
      });

      auditMutation("view", { view: "landing" });
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // START PACK & ROOM NAVIGATION
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    startPack(packId) {
      const packKey = packId === "sarcasm_academy_ultra" ? "sarcasm" : "careers";
      if (!LESSON_PACKS[packKey]) return;

      this.state.lessonPackId = packKey;
      this.state.currentRoomIndex = 0;
      this.state.startTime = Date.now();

      if (this.dom.landing) this.dom.landing.style.display = "none";
      if (this.dom.classroom) this.dom.classroom.style.display = "flex";

      this.renderRoom(true);
      this.updateHUD();
      auditMutation("start_pack", { packId: packKey });
    }

    nav(delta) {
      if (!this.state.lessonPackId) return;

      const pack = LESSON_PACKS[this.state.lessonPackId];
      const maxIndex = pack.rooms.length - 1;
      const newIndex = this.state.currentRoomIndex + delta;

      if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex > maxIndex) return;

      this.state.currentRoomIndex = newIndex;
      this.renderRoom();
      this.updateHUD();
      auditMutation("nav_room", {
        packId: this.state.lessonPackId,
        roomIndex: newIndex
      });
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // ROOM RENDERING WITH ANIMATION & TRANSLATION HANDLING
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    getRenderedContent(rawContent) {
      // simple EN/VN selector based on `[translate: ...]`
      const match = rawContent.match(/\[translate:([\s\S]+)]/);
      if (!match) return rawContent;
      if (this.state.lang === "vi") {
        return match[1].trim();
      } else {
        // remove translate marker for EN
        return rawContent.replace(/\[translate:[\s\S]+]/, "").trim();
      }
    }

    renderRoom(isFirst = false) {
      if (!this.dom.rooms) return;
      const pack = LESSON_PACKS[this.state.lessonPackId];
      const room = pack.rooms[this.state.currentRoomIndex];

      const isLast = this.state.currentRoomIndex === pack.rooms.length - 1;
      const showBack = this.state.currentRoomIndex > 0;

      const navButtons = `
        <div class="room-nav">
          ${showBack ? `<button class="room-btn" data-action="prev-room">Back</button>` : ""}
          ${
            isLast

      if (isFirst || !this.dom.rooms.firstElementChild) {

      this.dom.rooms.appendChild(newRoom);
      oldRoom.classList.add("view-slide-out");
      newRoom.classList.add("view-slide-in");

  oldRoom.classList.add("view-slide-out");

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PART 5: ENGINE CLASS – STATE, EVENTS, STORY LOGIC, RENDERING
   ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

class SarcasmCareersEngine {
  constructor() {
    this.state = {
      lessonPackId: null,
      currentRoomIndex: 0,
      coins: 100,
      score: 0,
      streak: 0,
      lang: "en",
      isTransitioning: false,
      startTime: 0,
      storyFlags: {
        introSeen: false,
        coreConceptsUnlocked: false,
        sarcasmQuizPassed: false,
        careersQuizPassed: false
      },
      difficulty: "normal"
    };

    this.dom = this.cacheDOM();
    this.sfx = this.initAudio();
    this.bindEvents();
    this.renderLanding();
    this.updateHUD();
  }

  /* ---------- DOM & AUDIO ---------- */

  cacheDOM() {
    return {
      landing: document.getElementById("landing"),
      classroom: document.getElementById("classroom"),
      accordion: document.getElementById("lesson-accordion"),
      rooms: document.getElementById("rooms-container"),
      hud: {
        score: document.getElementById("team1Score"),
        streak: document.getElementById("team2Score"),
        coins: document.getElementById("hud-coins")
      }
    };
  }

  initAudio() {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) {
      return {
        play: () => {}
      };
    }

    const ctx = new AudioCtx();

    return {
      play: (type) => {
        try {
          if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
          const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = ctx.createGain();

          osc.type = type === "correct" ? "triangle" : "square";
          osc.frequency.value = type === "correct" ? 600 : 150;

          gain.gain.value = type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.15;
          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(ctx.destination);

          osc.start();
          osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.3));
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("[SFX] Failed to play sound", e);
        }
      }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- EVENT BINDING (DELEGATED) ---------- */

  bindEvents() {
    // Main delegated click handler
    document.body.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      // Quiz handling
      const quizButton = e.target.closest(".chatty-choices button");
      if (quizButton) {
        this.handleQuizClick(quizButton);
        return;
      }

      // Action based handling
      const btn = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
      if (!btn) return;
      const action = btn.dataset.action;

      switch (action) {
        case "start-pack":
          this.startPack(btn.dataset.packId);
          break;
        case "next-room":
          this.nav(1);
          break;
        case "prev-room":
          this.nav(-1);
          break;
        case "return-home":
          this.returnHome();
          break;
        case "toggle-lang":
          this.toggleLang();
          break;
        case "buy-hint":
          this.buyHint(btn);
          break;
        case "speak":
          this.handleSpeak(btn);
          break;
        case "toggle-accordion":
          this.toggleAccordion(btn);
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- LANDING & PACK SELECTION ---------- */

  renderLanding() {
    if (!this.dom.landing) return;
    if (this.dom.classroom) this.dom.classroom.style.display = "none";
    this.dom.landing.style.display = "flex";

    if (!this.dom.accordion) return;
    this.dom.accordion.innerHTML = "";

    Object.values(LESSON_PACKS).forEach((pack) => {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "lesson-pack-card";

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="lesson-pack-header" data-action="toggle-accordion">
          <div class="feature-icon">${pack.icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="feature-title">${pack.title}</div>
            <p>${pack.description}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sublesson-container">
          <button class="room-btn-hint"
                  data-action="start-pack"
                  data-pack-id="${pack.id}">
            Start "${pack.title}"
          </button>
        </div>
      `;

      this.dom.accordion.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  startPack(packId) {
    if (!LESSON_PACKS[packId]) return;

    this.state.lessonPackId = packId;
    this.state.currentRoomIndex = 0;
    this.state.storyFlags = {
      introSeen: false,
      coreConceptsUnlocked: false,
      sarcasmQuizPassed: false,
      careersQuizPassed: false
    };
    this.state.difficulty = "normal";
    this.state.streak = 0;

    if (this.dom.landing) this.dom.landing.style.display = "none";
    if (this.dom.classroom) this.dom.classroom.style.display = "flex";

    this.renderRoom(true);
    this.updateHUD();
    auditMutation("start_pack", { packId });
  }

  returnHome() {
    this.state.lessonPackId = null;
    this.state.currentRoomIndex = 0;
    this.renderLanding();
    this.updateHUD();
    auditMutation("return_home", {});
  }

  /* ---------- LANGUAGE TOGGLE & CONTENT RENDERING ---------- */

  toggleLang() {
    this.state.lang = this.state.lang === "en" ? "vi" : "en";
    if (this.state.lessonPackId) {
      this.renderRoom(true);
    }
    this.updateHUD();
    auditMutation("toggle_lang", { lang: this.state.lang });
  }

  getRenderedContent(raw) {
    if (!raw) return "";
    const lang = this.state.lang;

    if (lang === "vi") {
      return raw.replace(/\[translate:([^\]]+)\]/g, "$1");
    }

    // Default: EN – strip translate hints but keep original text
    return raw.replace(/\[translate:[^\]]+\]/g, "");
  }

  /* ---------- STORY & DIFFICULTY HELPERS ---------- */

  getCurrentRoom() {
    if (!this.state.lessonPackId) return null;
    const pack = LESSON_PACKS[this.state.lessonPackId];
    return pack.rooms[this.state.currentRoomIndex] || null;
  }

  getCurrentRoomId() {
    const room = this.getCurrentRoom();
    return room ? room.id : "";
  }

  /* ---------- ROOM NAVIGATION WITH STORY GATES ---------- */

  nav(delta) {
    if (!this.state.lessonPackId) return;
    if (this.state.isTransitioning) return;

    const pack = LESSON_PACKS[this.state.lessonPackId];
    const maxIndex = pack.rooms.length - 1;
    const newIndex = this.state.currentRoomIndex + delta;

    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex > maxIndex) return;

    const targetRoom = pack.rooms[newIndex];
    const flags = this.state.storyFlags;

    // Gate: intro must be seen
    if (delta > 0 && !flags.introSeen && targetRoom.id !== pack.rooms[0].id) {
      this.showGateMessage("You need to complete the introduction first.");
      return;
    }

    // Gate: sarcasm quiz before mastery
    if (
      this.state.lessonPackId === "sarcasm" &&
      targetRoom.id === "sarcasm_mastery" &&
      !flags.sarcasmQuizPassed
    ) {
      this.showGateMessage("You need to pass the sarcasm quiz before exiting.");
      return;
    }

    // Gate: careers quiz before mastery
    if (
      this.state.lessonPackId === "careers" &&
      targetRoom.id === "careers_mastery" &&
      !flags.careersQuizPassed
    ) {
      this.showGateMessage("You need to pass the careers quiz before exiting.");
      return;
    }

    this.state.currentRoomIndex = newIndex;

    if (newIndex === 0) {
      this.state.storyFlags.introSeen = true;
    }

    this.renderRoom();
    this.updateHUD();
    auditMutation("nav_room", {
      packId: this.state.lessonPackId,
      roomIndex: newIndex
    });
  }

  showGateMessage(msg) {
    const container = this.dom.classroom || document.body;
    let banner = container.querySelector(".story-gate-banner");
    if (!banner) {
      banner = document.createElement("div");
      banner.className = "story-gate-banner";
      container.prepend(banner);
    }
    banner.textContent = msg;
    banner.setAttribute("data-visible", "true");
    setTimeout(() => banner && banner.setAttribute("data-visible", "false"), 2500);
  }

  /* ---------- QUIZ HANDLING & ADAPTIVE DIFFICULTY ---------- */

  handleQuizClick(btn) {
    const parent = btn.closest(".chatty-choices");
    if (!parent) return;
    const feedback = parent.nextElementSibling;
    const isCorrect = btn.dataset.answer === "correct";

    const packId = this.state.lessonPackId;
    const roomId = this.getCurrentRoomId();

    if (isCorrect) {
      feedback.textContent =
        parent.dataset.correctFeedback || "✅ Correct!";
      feedback.className = "chatty-feedback feedback-correct";
      this.state.score += 10;
      this.state.streak += 1;
      this.state.coins += 10;
      this.sfx.play("correct");
      triggerHaptics("correct");

      if (packId === "sarcasm" && roomId === "sarcasm_quiz") {
        this.state.storyFlags.sarcasmQuizPassed = true;
      }
      if (packId === "careers" && roomId === "careers_quiz") {
        this.state.storyFlags.careersQuizPassed = true;
      }
    } else {
      feedback.textContent =
        parent.dataset.wrongFeedback || "❌ Try again.";
      feedback.className = "chatty-feedback feedback-wrong";
      this.state.streak = 0;
      this.sfx.play("wrong");
      triggerHaptics("wrong");
    }

    // Adaptive difficulty
    if (this.state.streak >= 3) {
      this.state.difficulty = "hard";
    } else if (this.state.streak === 0) {
      this.state.difficulty = "easy";
    } else {
      this.state.difficulty = "normal";
    }

    if (this.state.difficulty === "easy" && !isCorrect) {
      if (!feedback.textContent.includes("HINT")) {
        feedback.textContent +=
          " 💡 HINT: Look for a mismatch between words and reality or exaggerated praise.";
      }
    }

    parent.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b) => (b.disabled = true));
    this.updateHUD();
    auditMutation("quiz_answer", {
      packId,
      roomId,
      isCorrect,
      difficulty: this.state.difficulty
    });
  }

  /* ---------- ROOM RENDERING (P1-HARDENED) ---------- */

  renderRoom(isFirst = false) {
    if (!this.dom.rooms) return;
    const pack = LESSON_PACKS[this.state.lessonPackId];
    const room = pack.rooms[this.state.currentRoomIndex];

    const isLast = this.state.currentRoomIndex === pack.rooms.length - 1;
    const showBack = this.state.currentRoomIndex > 0;

    const frame = document.createElement("div");
    frame.className = "room";

    const graphicEl = document.createElement("div");
    graphicEl.className = "scene-graphic";
    graphicEl.textContent = room.graphic;
    frame.appendChild(graphicEl);

    const titleRow = document.createElement("div");
    titleRow.className = "title-row";

    const titleSpan = document.createElement("span");
    titleSpan.textContent = room.title;

    const labelSpan = document.createElement("span");
    labelSpan.className = "room-label";
    labelSpan.textContent = room.label;

    titleRow.appendChild(titleSpan);
    titleRow.appendChild(labelSpan);
    frame.appendChild(titleRow);

    const contentEl = document.createElement("div");
    contentEl.className = "room-content";
    contentEl.innerHTML = this.getRenderedContent(room.content);
    frame.appendChild(contentEl);

    const navEl = document.createElement("div");
    navEl.className = "room-nav";

    if (showBack) {
      const backBtn = document.createElement("button");
      backBtn.className = "room-btn";
      backBtn.dataset.action = "prev-room";
      backBtn.textContent = "Back";
      navEl.appendChild(backBtn);
    }

    const primaryBtn = document.createElement("button");
    primaryBtn.className = "room-btn";

    if (isLast) {
      primaryBtn.dataset.action = "return-home";
      primaryBtn.textContent = "Finish Lesson";
    } else {
      primaryBtn.dataset.action = "next-room";
      primaryBtn.textContent = "Next";
    }
    navEl.appendChild(primaryBtn);

    frame.appendChild(navEl);

    if (isFirst || !this.dom.rooms.firstElementChild) {
      this.dom.rooms.innerHTML = "";
      this.dom.rooms.appendChild(frame);
      return;
    }

    const oldRoom = this.dom.rooms.firstElementChild;
    this.state.isTransitioning = true;

    frame.classList.add("view-slide-in");
    oldRoom.classList.add("view-slide-out");
    this.dom.rooms.appendChild(frame);

    oldRoom.addEventListener(
      "animationend",
      () => {
        oldRoom.remove();
        this.state.isTransitioning = false;
      },
      { once: true }
    );
  }

  /* ---------- HUD, HINTS, SPEECH, ACCORDION ---------- */

  updateHUD() {
    const hud = this.dom.hud || {};
    if (hud.score) hud.score.textContent = this.state.score;
    if (hud.streak) hud.streak.textContent = `🔥 ${this.state.streak}`;
    if (hud.coins) hud.coins.textContent = `💰 ${this.state.coins}`;
  }

  buyHint(btn) {
    if (this.state.coins < 25) return;
    this.state.coins -= 25;
    this.updateHUD();

    const hint = btn.dataset.hint || "💡 HINT: Pay attention to the key words.";
    const feedback = document.querySelector(".chatty-feedback");
    if (feedback) {
      feedback.textContent = hint;
      feedback.className = "chatty-feedback feedback-hint";
    }
    btn.disabled = true;
    auditMutation("buy_hint", { cost: 25 });
  }

  handleSpeak(btn) {
    if (!window.speechSynthesis) return;
    try {
      const container = btn.closest(".dialogue-block") || btn.parentElement;
      const text = container.textContent.replace("🔊", "").trim();
      const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utter.rate = 0.9;
      utter.pitch = 1.0;
      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      auditMutation("speak", { textSnippet: text.slice(0, 80) });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[SPEECH] Failed to speak text", e);
    }
  }

  toggleAccordion(btn) {
    const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
    if (!content) return;
    if (content.style.maxHeight) {
      content.style.maxHeight = null;
    } else {
      content.style.maxHeight = content.scrollHeight + "px";
    }
  }
}

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <title>NET App V0 — Buddy System First</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      --color-bg: #0f0f1a;
      --color-card-bg: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.8);
      --color-border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
      --color-purple: #a855f7;
      --color-gold: #f59e0b;
      --color-text: #e5e7eb;
      --shadow-soft: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6), 0 0 8px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      --radius-lg: 1.5rem;
      --transition-fast: 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55);
      --glass-blur: 12px; /* Gospel 444 minimum */
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter", sans-serif;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, rgba(168,85,247,0.25) 0, transparent 55%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(245,158,11,0.22) 0, transparent 60%),
                  var(--color-bg);
      color: var(--color-text);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: stretch;
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }

    .app-shell {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      min-height: 90vh;
      border-radius: 1.75rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,15,26,0.95), rgba(15,15,26,0.7));
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15);
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      display: flex;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Ambient blobs (background depth, no blue) */
    .blob {
      position: absolute;
      width: 260px;
      height: 260px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.55;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      animation: blob-move 18s infinite alternate;
    }
    .blob--left {
      left: -60px;
      top: -40px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(168,85,247,0.9), transparent 70%);
    }
    .blob--right {
      right: -80px;
      bottom: -40px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245,158,11,0.9), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: 4s;
    }
    @keyframes blob-move {
      0% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(40px,-30px,0) scale(1.08); }
    }

    /* Sidebar */
    .sidebar {
      width: 240px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(150%);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,15,26,0.95), rgba(15,15,26,0.75));
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2);
      padding: 1.5rem 1.4rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.75rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .logo-lockup {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .logo-orb {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--color-purple), transparent 70%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(168,85,247,0.95);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .logo-text-main {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .logo-text-sub {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    .nav-section-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .nav-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .nav-btn {
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      color: rgba(226,232,240,0.8);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast),
                  box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast),
                  color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-btn-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .nav-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(148,163,184,0.7);
    }

    .nav-tag {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.1rem 0.55rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.5);
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .nav-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.7);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: rgba(148,163,184,0.5);
    }

    .nav-btn--active {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%, rgba(168,85,247,0.35), transparent 65%);
      border-color: var(--color-purple);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .nav-btn--active .nav-dot {
      background: var(--color-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.9);
    }

    .sidebar-footer {
      margin-top: auto;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      opacity: 0.65;
    }

    .sidebar-footer-strong {
      color: var(--color-gold);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Main content */
    .main {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .top-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .page-title-block {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .page-eyebrow {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.85);
    }

    .page-title {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .page-title span {
      color: var(--color-purple);
    }

    .page-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.9);
    }

    .metric-chip-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .metric-chip {
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.8);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.45);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .metric-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--color-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.8);
    }

    /* Cards layout */
    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 1.2rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .app-shell {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .sidebar {
        width: 100%;
        flex-direction: row;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 1rem;
        overflow-x: auto;
      }
      .nav-section-label,
      .sidebar-footer {
        display: none;
      }
      .main {
        padding: 1.2rem;
      }
      .grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.98), rgba(15,23,42,0.78));
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(15,23,42,0.85);
      padding: 1.2rem 1.1rem;
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(155%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .card-title-block {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.15rem;
    }

    .card-title {
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .card-kicker {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.95);
    }

    .card-pill {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.5);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%, rgba(168,85,247,0.35), transparent 65%);
      color: var(--color-text);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
    }

    .card-pill-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--color-gold);
    }

    .card-body {
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      color: rgba(226,232,240,0.95);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.7rem;
    }

    .tag-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .tag {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.55);
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);
    }

    .tag--success {
      border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.7);
      color: #bbf7d0;
    }

    .tag--pending {
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.7);
      color: #fed7aa;
    }

    /* Buddy list */
    .buddy-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-top: 0.35rem;
    }

    .buddy-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.55rem;
      border-radius: 0.9rem;
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(30,64,175,0); /* no blue shadow, keep transparent */
      transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .buddy-row:hover {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%, rgba(168,85,247,0.25), transparent 70%);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(168,85,247,0.55);
    }

    .buddy-main {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }

    .buddy-avatar {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(168,85,247,0.4), transparent 65%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.6);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .buddy-name {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .buddy-meta {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.95);
    }

    .buddy-stat-pill {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      padding: 0.18rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.7);
      background: rgba(24,16,6,0.9);
      color: #fed7aa;
    }

    /* Challenge Builder */
    .field-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.2rem;
      margin-top: 0.3rem;
    }

    .field-label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.95);
    }

    .field-input,
    .field-select,
    .field-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 0.85rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.6);
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.95);
      color: var(--color-text);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .field-input:focus,
    .field-select:focus,
    .field-textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-purple);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(168,85,247,0.6);
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.98);
    }

    .field-textarea {
      min-height: 80px;
      resize: vertical;
    }

    .btn-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
    }

    .btn {
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast),
                  box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.9);
      border-color: rgba(148,163,184,0.6);
      color: rgba(226,232,240,0.9);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(15,23,42,0.98);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(148,163,184,0.7);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%, rgba(168,85,247,0.9), rgba(245,158,11,0.9));
      border-color: rgba(248,250,252,0.85);
      color: #0f0f1a;
      font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(168,85,247,0.9), 0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.85);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.01);
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(168,85,247,1), 0 0 14px rgba(245,158,11,0.95);
    }

    .status-line {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: rgba(148,163,184,0.95);
      margin-top: 0.45rem;
    }

    .status-line span {
      color: var(--color-gold);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Utility hide */
    .hidden {
      display: none !important;
    }

  </style>

  <script>
    // --- Simple App State (front-end only, no storage yet) ---
    const state = {
      activeView: "dashboard",
      streakDays: 3,
      minutesToday: 30,
      buddies: [
        {
          id: "nhan",
          name: "Nhan",
          level: "B1 • Creative",
          focus: "Confidence & volume",
          sessionsThisWeek: 1,
          archetype: "Low-volume / shy"
        },
        {
          id: "kiet",
          name: "Kiet",
          level: "C1 • Teen Genius",
          focus: "Deep topics & debates",
          sessionsThisWeek: 0,
          archetype: "Advanced / fast-thinker"
        },
        {
          id: "quang",
          name: "Quang",
          level: "B1 • University",
          focus: "Presentations & phrasing",
          sessionsThisWeek: 0,
          archetype: "Corporate / student"
        }
      ],
      selectedBuddyId: null,
      lockedSession: null
    };

    // --- DOM references ---
    const navButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn"));
    const eyebrowEl = document.getElementById("view-eyebrow");
    const titleEl = document.getElementById("view-title");
    const subtitleEl = document.getElementById("view-subtitle");
    const metricStreakEl = document.getElementById("metric-streak");
    const metricTodayEl = document.getElementById("metric-today");
    const metricNextBuddyEl = document.getElementById("metric-next-buddy");
    const views = {
      dashboard: document.getElementById("view-dashboard"),
      lessons: document.getElementById("view-lessons"),
      buddies: document.getElementById("view-buddies"),
      community: document.getElementById("view-community"),
      settings: document.getElementById("view-settings")
    };
    const buddyListEl = document.getElementById("buddy-list");
    const buddyStatusLine = document.getElementById("buddy-status-line");
    const sessionGoalEl = document.getElementById("session-goal");
    const sessionLengthEl = document.getElementById("session-length");
    const sessionTopicEl = document.getElementById("session-topic");
    const sessionNotesEl = document.getElementById("session-notes");
    const sessionStatusLine = document.getElementById("session-status-line");
    const btnFillTemplate = document.getElementById("btn-fill-template");
    const btnLockSession = document.getElementById("btn-lock-session");

    // --- View meta text ---
    const viewMeta = {
      dashboard: {
        eyebrow: "NET • Buddy-First Build",
        title: "Welcome back, Student",
        subtitle: "1 hour a day, confidence for life. Buddy System is the core of V0."
      },
      lessons: {
        eyebrow: "NET • Academies Overview",
        title: "Your Lesson Worlds",
        subtitle: "Sarcasm, Careers, Context, Pronunciation — all waiting for StoryFlow."
      },
      buddies: {
        eyebrow: "NET • Buddy System Core",
        title: "Practice with Real People",
        subtitle: "You don’t beat fear alone. You beat it laughing with a partner."
      },
      community: {
        eyebrow: "NET • Community Universe",
        title: "Networking Nights & Events",
        subtitle: "From Zoom calls to real tables in Saigon. English has to leave the classroom."
      },
      settings: {
        eyebrow: "NET • Personal Settings",
        title: "Tune Your Experience",
        subtitle: "The right content at the right time makes the habit stick."
      }
    };

    function setActiveView(view) {
      state.activeView = view;

      // Update nav
      navButtons.forEach(btn => {
        if (btn.dataset.view === view) {
          btn.classList.add("nav-btn--active");
        } else {
          btn.classList.remove("nav-btn--active");
        }
      });

      // Show/Hide sections
      Object.entries(views).forEach(([key, section]) => {
        if (key === view) {
          section.classList.remove("hidden");
        } else {
          section.classList.add("hidden");
        }
      });

      // Update header text
      const meta = viewMeta[view];
      if (meta) {
        eyebrowEl.textContent = meta.eyebrow;
        titleEl.innerHTML = ""; // rebuild carefully to allow span color
        const text = meta.title;
        const spanIndex = text.indexOf("Student");
        if (view === "dashboard" && spanIndex !== -1) {
          // simple span injection: static, not user content
          const before = text.slice(0, spanIndex);
          const after = text.slice(spanIndex + "Student".length);
          const span = document.createElement("span");
          span.textContent = "Student";
          titleEl.append(before, span, after);
        } else {
          titleEl.textContent = text;
        }
        subtitleEl.textContent = meta.subtitle;
      }
    }

    function renderMetrics() {
      metricStreakEl.textContent = state.streakDays + " days";
      metricTodayEl.textContent = state.minutesToday + " / 60 min";
      // In V0 we keep buddy metric static; can link to real schedule later
      metricNextBuddyEl.textContent = "This week";
    }

    function renderBuddyList() {
      buddyListEl.innerHTML = ""; // static template, no user data HTML injection

      state.buddies.forEach(buddy => {
        const row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "buddy-row";
        row.dataset.buddyId = buddy.id;

        const main = document.createElement("div");
        main.className = "buddy-main";

        const avatar = document.createElement("div");
        avatar.className = "buddy-avatar";
        avatar.textContent = buddy.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

        const info = document.createElement("div");
        const nameEl = document.createElement("div");
        nameEl.className = "buddy-name";
        nameEl.textContent = buddy.name;
        const metaEl = document.createElement("div");
        metaEl.className = "buddy-meta";
        metaEl.textContent = buddy.level + " • " + buddy.focus;

        info.appendChild(nameEl);
        info.appendChild(metaEl);

        main.appendChild(avatar);
        main.appendChild(info);

        const statPill = document.createElement("div");
        statPill.className = "buddy-stat-pill";
        statPill.textContent = buddy.sessionsThisWeek + "x this week";

        row.appendChild(main);
        row.appendChild(statPill);

        row.addEventListener("click", () => {
          state.selectedBuddyId = buddy.id;
          updateBuddyStatus();
          highlightSelectedBuddy();
        });

        buddyListEl.appendChild(row);
      });

      updateBuddyStatus();
      highlightSelectedBuddy();
    }

    function updateBuddyStatus() {
      const span = buddyStatusLine.querySelector("span");
      if (!span) return;
      if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
        span.textContent = "None yet";
      } else {
        const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
        if (buddy) {
          span.textContent = buddy.name + " (" + buddy.level + ")";
        }
      }
    }

    function highlightSelectedBuddy() {
      const rows = buddyListEl.querySelectorAll(".buddy-row");
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const id = row.dataset.buddyId;
        if (id === state.selectedBuddyId) {
          row.style.boxShadow = "0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,0.85)";
          row.style.borderColor = "rgba(245,158,11,0.9)";
        } else {
          row.style.boxShadow = "none";
          row.style.borderColor = "rgba(30,64,175,0)";
        }
      });
    }

    function autoFillSessionIdea() {
      // This uses only static templates; no user injection risk
      const goal = sessionGoalEl.value;
      const length = Number(sessionLengthEl.value);
      const topic = sessionTopicEl.value;

      let template = "";

      const warmup = "5 minutes: warm-up small talk about your day.\n";
      const review = "5 minutes: quick review — each person shares 1 thing they did well and 1 thing to improve.\n";

      if (goal === "confidence") {
        template += warmup;
        template += (length - 10) + " minutes: take turns telling a story about the topic. The listener must ask follow-up questions.\n";
        template += review;
      } else if (goal === "small-talk") {
        template += warmup;
        template += (length - 10) + " minutes: imagine you just met at a networking event. Practice natural questions and reactions.\n";
        template += review;
      } else if (goal === "business") {
        template += warmup;
        template += (length - 10) + " minutes: role-play a short meeting or email discussion about work tasks.\n";
        template += review;
      } else if (goal === "pronunciation") {
        template += warmup;
        template += (length - 10) + " minutes: choose 5–8 sentences and drill volume, rhythm, and key sounds.\n";
        template += review;
      } else if (goal === "storytelling") {
        template += warmup;
        template += (length - 10) + " minutes: tell one strong story each. Focus on past tense, feelings, and details.\n";
        template += review;
      }

      if (topic === "weekend") {
        template += "\nTopic guide: what you did last weekend, funny moments, anything that went wrong.";
      } else if (topic === "work") {
        template += "\nTopic guide: this week at work — wins, problems, one conversation with your boss.";
      } else if (topic === "dreams") {
        template += "\nTopic guide: your dream job, country, or project in the next 5–10 years.";
      } else if (topic === "travel") {
        template += "\nTopic guide: best trip so far, where you want to go next, culture shocks.";
      } else if (topic === "movies") {
        template += "\nTopic guide: your favorite series or movie, why you like it, characters you relate to.";
      }

      sessionNotesEl.value = template;
      sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Draft generated. Edit anything you want, then lock this session.";
    }

    function lockSession() {
      if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
        sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";
        return;
      }
      const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
      const plan = sessionNotesEl.value.trim();
      if (!plan) {
        sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";
        return;
      }

      state.lockedSession = {
        buddyId: buddy.id,
        goal: sessionGoalEl.value,
        length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),
        topic: sessionTopicEl.value,
        notes: plan
      };

      sessionStatusLine.textContent =
        "Session locked with " + buddy.name +
        " for " + state.lockedSession.length +
        " minutes. The only job now: show up.";

      // In future, this would also:
      // - Save to backend / localStorage
      // - Sync with NET PET
      // - Trigger reminders
    }

    // --- Event wiring ---
    navButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const view = btn.dataset.view;
        if (!view) return;
        setActiveView(view);
      });
    });

    btnFillTemplate.addEventListener("click", autoFillSessionIdea);
    btnLockSession.addEventListener("click", lockSession);

    // --- Initial render ---
    renderMetrics();
    renderBuddyList();
    setActiveView("dashboard");
  </script>
</body>
</html>

// --- Security & Persistence Functions (P0/P1 Hardening) ---

// MANDATE: P1 Input Sanitation. Blocks script and tag injection.
function sanitizeInput(input) {
  // Use textContent property of a temporary element to safely escape HTML.
  const temp = document.createElement('div');
  temp.textContent = input;
  return temp.innerHTML; // This is safe because user-provided content is already escaped.
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Saves state (simulating hashState_SHA256 verification).
function saveState() {
  try {
    const stateToSave = JSON.stringify(state);
    // In full Phoenix, this would be encrypted and hashed before setting.
    localStorage.setItem('netAppState', stateToSave); 
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("PHOENIX AUDIT: Could not save state to local storage.", e);
  }
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Loads state on initialization.
function loadState() {
  try {
    const savedState = localStorage.getItem('netAppState');
    if (savedState) {
      const parsedState = JSON.parse(savedState);
      // Merge saved properties back into initial state
      Object.assign(state, parsedState);
      renderAll(); // Rerender UI based on loaded state
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("PHOENIX AUDIT: Corrupted state found. Starting new session.");
  }
}

// --- Hardened Lock Session Function ---
function lockSession() {
  if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";
    return;
  }
  const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
  
  // *** HARDENING: SANITIZE USER INPUT BEFORE STORING ***
  const sanitizedPlan = sanitizeInput(sessionNotesEl.value);

  if (!sanitizedPlan) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";
    return;
  }

  state.lockedSession = {
    buddyId: buddy.id,
    goal: sessionGoalEl.value,
    length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),
    topic: sessionTopicEl.value,
    notes: sanitizedPlan // Store the sanitized data
  };

  // *** PERSISTENCE MANDATE: SAVE STATE AFTER CRITICAL ACTION ***
  saveState(); 

  sessionStatusLine.textContent =
    "Session locked with " + buddy.name +
    " for " + state.lockedSession.length +
    " minutes. The only job now: show up.";
}

// --- Modified Initializer and Renders ---
function renderAll() {
  renderMetrics();
  renderBuddyList();
  setActiveView(state.activeView);
}

// --- INITIALIZATION ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  loadState(); // Load state on DOM ready
  renderAll(); // Initial render based on loaded or default state

  // Attach event listeners after loading state and rendering
  navButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const view = e.currentTarget.dataset.view;
      if (view) setActiveView(view);
    });
  });

  btnFillTemplate.addEventListener("click", autoFillSessionIdea);
  // Redefine lockSession listener to use the hardened version
  btnLockSession.addEventListener("click", lockSession); 
});

// src/core/storage.js
import { NET_STATE } from "./state.js";
import { hashState } from "../security/hash.js";

const STORAGE_KEY = "NET_APP_STATE_V1";

export function loadState() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return;

    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    // Optional: verify integrity hash inside parsed.meta
    Object.assign(NET_STATE, parsed.data || {});
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[Sync_Core] Corrupted state, starting fresh.", err);
  }
}

export async function saveState() {
  try {
    const data = {
      data: NET_STATE,
      meta: {
        version: NET_STATE.version,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    };
    const hash = await hashState(data);
    data.meta.hash = hash;

    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[Chatty Prime] Failed to persist state.", err);
  }
}
hash.js (browser SubtleCrypto wrapper)
// src/security/hash.js
export async function hashState(obj) {
  const json = JSON.stringify(obj);
  const enc = new TextEncoder().encode(json);

  if (!crypto || !crypto.subtle) {
    console.warn("[Chatty Prime] SubtleCrypto not available; hash skipped.");
    return "NO_HASH_ENV";
  }

  const buffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", enc);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  return Array.from(bytes)
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join("");
}

  return temp.textContent; // stays as plain text
}
6. UI Components
GlassCard.js
// src/ui/components/GlassCard.js
export function GlassCard({ title, body, footer } = {}) {
  const card = document.createElement("section");
  card.className = "glass-card";

  if (title) {
    const h = document.createElement("h2");
    h.className = "glass-card__title";
    h.textContent = title;
    card.appendChild(h);
  }

  if (body) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "glass-card__body";
    if (typeof body === "string") {
      div.textContent = body;
    } else {
      div.appendChild(body);
    }
    card.appendChild(div);
  }

  if (footer) {
    const f = document.createElement("div");
    f.className = "glass-card__footer";
    if (typeof footer === "string") {
      f.textContent = footer;
    } else {
      f.appendChild(footer);
    }
    card.appendChild(f);
  }

  return card;
}
BuddyRow.js
// src/ui/components/BuddyRow.js
export function BuddyRow(buddy, { onSelect } = {}) {
  const row = document.createElement("button");
  row.className = "buddy-row";
  row.type = "button";
  row.dataset.id = buddy.id;

  const name = document.createElement("span");
  name.className = "buddy-row__name";
  name.textContent = buddy.name;

  const level = document.createElement("span");
  level.className = "buddy-row__level";
  level.textContent = buddy.level;

  row.appendChild(name);
  row.appendChild(level);

  if (onSelect) {
    row.addEventListener("click", () => onSelect(buddy));
  }

  return row;
}

    const btn = e.target.closest("[data-view]");
    if (!btn) return;

    const view = btn.dataset.view;
    if (!view) return;

    NET_STATE.activeView = view;
    renderActiveView(rootEl);
    saveState();
  });
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
  const rootEl = document.querySelector("#app");
  if (!rootEl) {
    console.error("No #app root found");
    return;
  }

  loadState();
  renderActiveView(rootEl);
  setupNav(rootEl);
});

(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 0. INTERNAL CONFIG
