      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.08);
    }

    .faq-item:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .faq-header {
      padding: 8px 2px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
    }

    .faq-question {
      flex: 1;
    }

    .faq-toggle {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.6);
    }

    .faq-body {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.25s ease-out;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      padding: 0 2px;
    }

    .faq-body-inner {
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-body {
      max-height: 200px;
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-toggle {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      color: var(--gold);
    }

    /* Footer */
    footer.app-footer {
      padding: 6px 14px 8px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-mark {
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);
      font-size: 0.62rem;
    }

    .foot-pill {
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.18);
    }

    @media (max-width: 380px) {
      .hero-title {
        font-size: 1.18rem;
      }
      .hero-subtitle {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
      }
      .pulse-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app-shell">
    <div class="app-inner">
      <header class="app-header">
        <div class="brand-block">
          <div class="brand-line">NET PET AI · V1</div>
          <div class="brand-tagline">Your daily English coach, not a textbook.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="streak-chip">
          <span class="streak-dot"></span>
          <span><span id="streak-count">0</span> day streak</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main class="app-main" id="scroll-root">
        <!-- HERO -->
        <section id="section-hero">
          <div class="hero-card">
            <div class="hero-comet"></div>
            <div class="section-label">The coach that works for you</div>
            <h1 class="hero-title">
              Build your <span class="hero-accent">English lifestyle</span>
              <br />45 · 15 · Every day.
            </h1>
            <p class="hero-subtitle">
              NET PET tracks your listening, pushes your speaking, and refuses to let you stay a mouse.
            </p>
            <div class="hero-cta-row">
              <button class="btn-pill btn-primary" id="cta-log-today">
                Log today’s study
              </button>
              <button class="btn-pill btn-secondary" id="cta-what-can">
                What can NET PET do?
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- PULSE + DIALOGUE -->
        <section id="section-pulse">
          <div class="section-label">Today’s energy</div>
          <div class="pulse-card">
            <div class="avatar-stack">
              <div class="avatar-ring"></div>
              <div class="avatar-ring inner"></div>
              <div class="avatar-core" id="pet-avatar"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="pulse-meta">
              <div class="pulse-title">Your English Energy</div>
              <div class="pulse-sub" id="pulse-status">
                Let’s see if today looks like a tiger or a mouse.
              </div>
              <div class="pulse-chip-row">
                <div class="chip chip-heat" id="chip-mood">Mood: Neutral</div>
                <div class="chip" id="chip-goal">Goal: Not complete</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="dialogue-card">
            <div id="ai-line">
              "Initializing neural link. I’m here to keep you honest, not comfortable."
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- TRACKER -->
        <section id="section-tracker">
          <div class="section-label">45 / 15 tracker</div>
          <div class="tracker-card">
            <div class="tracker-row">
              <div class="tracker-label">
                <span>Listening (Fun Input)</span>
                <span id="listen-label">0 / 45m</span>
              </div>
              <div class="progress-shell">
                <div class="progress-fill listen" id="bar-listen"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tracker-row">
              <div class="tracker-label">
                <span>Speaking / Mimic</span>
                <span id="speak-label">0 / 15m</span>
              </div>
              <div class="progress-shell">
                <div class="progress-fill speak" id="bar-speak"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="tracker-buttons">
              <button class="btn-solid btn-listen" id="btn-log-listen">+15m Listening</button>
              <button class="btn-solid btn-speak" id="btn-log-speak">+5m Speaking</button>
            </div>
            <div class="tracker-footnote">
              Rule #1: 60% understanding minimum. Rule #2: No pausing. Rule #3: Make it fun.
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- CAPABILITIES — COMET STYLE AI THAT… -->
        <section id="section-capabilities">
          <div class="section-label">What NET PET can do</div>
          <div class="capabilities-card">
            <div class="capabilities-grid">
              <div class="capability-pill">
                <div class="cap-badge">AI that coaches</div>
                <div class="cap-title">Tough love when you’re hiding</div>
                <p class="cap-text">
                  If you only listen and never speak, NET PET flips into Coach Mode and pushes you out
                  of your comfort zone. No more “I’ll speak when I’m perfect”.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div class="capability-pill">
                <div class="cap-badge">AI that tracks</div>
                <div class="cap-title">Your 45·15 streak, day by day</div>
                <p class="cap-text">
                  It watches your listening and speaking time, day rollovers, and streaks – then
                  reacts when you break the habit or level up.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div class="capability-pill">
                <div class="cap-badge">AI that builds</div>
                <div class="cap-title">A lifestyle, not a cram session</div>
                <p class="cap-text">
                  Instead of “homework”, NET PET designs small, realistic daily wins so English becomes
                  part of your lifestyle, not a chore.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div class="capability-pill">
                <div class="cap-badge">AI that fixes</div>
                <div class="cap-title">Robot voice & mouse energy</div>
                <p class="cap-text">
                  It keeps reminding you to increase volume, mimic emotion, and laugh at mistakes –
                  so you stop sounding like a shy exam robot.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- FAQ -->
        <section id="section-faq">
          <div class="section-label">FAQ</div>
          <div class="faq-card">
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="faq-header">
                <div class="faq-question">What does NET PET actually track?</div>
                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>
              </div>
              <div class="faq-body">
                <div class="faq-body-inner">
                  Your daily listening minutes, speaking minutes, and whether you’ve hit the 45/15 goal
                  for the day. It also tracks your streak and mood state (neutral, tough love, proud).
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="faq-header">
                <div class="faq-question">What happens if I miss a day?</div>
                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>
              </div>
              <div class="faq-body">
                <div class="faq-body-inner">
                  If you miss your goal, the next day NET PET resets your streak and switches into
                  Tough Love mode. It doesn’t punish you – it just refuses to lie about your progress.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="faq-header">
                <div class="faq-question">Do I have to log exact minutes?</div>
                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>
              </div>
              <div class="faq-body">
                <div class="faq-body-inner">
                  No. The buttons are designed for quick logging. Each tap is a chunk of time:
                  15 minutes for listening, 5 minutes for speaking. You can tap multiple times
                  to match your real study.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="faq-header">
                <div class="faq-question">Is this a replacement for a teacher?</div>
                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>
              </div>
              <div class="faq-body">
                <div class="faq-body-inner">
                  No. NET PET is the daily accountability partner. The real transformation comes from
                  the combination of human teacher, NET lessons, and this AI coach watching your habits.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <footer class="app-footer">
        <span class="footer-mark">GOSPEL·444</span>
        <span class="foot-pill">Phoenix Engine · Buddy System Ready</span>
      </footer>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // ========================================================================
    // PHOENIX EVENT BUS (COMET-STYLE CORE)
    // ========================================================================
    const EventBus = {
      _subscribers: {},
      on(event, fn) {
        if (!this._subscribers[event]) this._subscribers[event] = [];
        this._subscribers[event].push(fn);
      },
      emit(event, payload) {
        (this._subscribers[event] || []).forEach(fn => fn(payload));
      }
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // STATE & CANONICAL CONSTANTS
    // ========================================================================
    const DEFAULT_STATE = {
      streak: 0,
      listeningMin: 0,
      speakingMin: 0,
      lastLogin: new Date().toDateString(),
      mood: "NEUTRAL", // NEUTRAL, TOUGH_LOVE, HAPPY, PROUD
      dailyGoalMet: false
    };

    let state;
    try {
      const fromStorage = localStorage.getItem("netPetV1State");
      state = fromStorage ? { ...DEFAULT_STATE, ...JSON.parse(fromStorage) } : { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
    } catch {
      state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
    }

    const GOAL_LISTEN = 45;
    const GOAL_SPEAK = 15;

    // Voice matrix grounded in your canonical tones
    const VOICE_MATRIX = {
      GREETING: [
        "Let’s get to work. Consistency beats intensity.",
        "Welcome back. Ready to break the grammar prison again?",
        "Remember: you learned Vietnamese by listening first. We do the same here.",
        "Today is another chance to be a tiger, not a mouse."
      ],
      TOUGH_LOVE: [
        "You haven’t practiced speaking yet. You can’t learn to swim by reading the water.",
        "Grammar won’t save you in a real meeting. Confidence will. Open your mouth.",
        "You built a whole wall around your mistakes. Let’s kick one brick out today.",
        "Do you want fluency or just the feeling of ‘studying’? The difference is action."
      ],
      CELEBRATION: [
        "Boom. You hit 45 and 15. That’s real English work, not homework.",
        "That’s the energy I want. Small wins, every day. This is how you become fluent.",
        "You’re not ‘learning English’ anymore – you’re living with English.",
        "Outstanding. Tomorrow, we just repeat this. Simple. Heavy. Effective."
      ],
      NUDGE: [
        "Pick one show you actually enjoy and listen. No pausing. Just let it wash over you.",
        "Five more minutes of shadowing could change how you sound next month.",
        "60% understanding is enough. Your brain will fill the rest if you keep going.",
        "If it’s fun, you’ll keep coming back. Let’s make the next 10 minutes fun."
      ]
    };

    // DOM Refs
    const streakCountEl = document.getElementById("streak-count");
    const avatarEl = document.getElementById("pet-avatar");
    const chipMoodEl = document.getElementById("chip-mood");
    const chipGoalEl = document.getElementById("chip-goal");
    const pulseStatusEl = document.getElementById("pulse-status");

    const listenLabelEl = document.getElementById("listen-label");
    const speakLabelEl = document.getElementById("speak-label");
    const listenBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-listen");
    const speakBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-speak");

    const aiLineEl = document.getElementById("ai-line");

    const btnLogListen = document.getElementById("btn-log-listen");
    const btnLogSpeak = document.getElementById("btn-log-speak");
    const ctaLogToday = document.getElementById("cta-log-today");
    const ctaWhatCan = document.getElementById("cta-what-can");
    const mainRoot = document.getElementById("scroll-root");

    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");

    // ========================================================================
    // HELPERS
    // ========================================================================
    function saveState() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("netPetV1State", JSON.stringify(state));
      } catch {
        // ignore storage errors
      }
      EventBus.emit("state:updated", { ...state });
    }

    function pickRandom(arr) {
      return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
    }

    function setLine(category) {
      const pool = VOICE_MATRIX[category];
      if (!pool || pool.length === 0) return;
      const line = pickRandom(pool);
      aiLineEl.textContent = `"${line}"`;
    }

    function todayString() {
      return new Date().toDateString();
    }

    // Check day rollover / slump detection
    function checkDayRollover() {
      const today = todayString();
      if (state.lastLogin !== today) {
        // New day
        if (state.dailyGoalMet) {
          state.streak += 1;
          state.mood = "HAPPY";
        } else {
          state.streak = 0;
          state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";
        }
        state.listeningMin = 0;
        state.speakingMin = 0;
        state.dailyGoalMet = false;
        state.lastLogin = today;
        saveState();
      }
    }

    function evaluateGoal() {
      if (state.listeningMin >= GOAL_LISTEN && state.speakingMin >= GOAL_SPEAK) {
        if (!state.dailyGoalMet) {
          state.dailyGoalMet = true;
          state.mood = "PROUD";
          setLine("CELEBRATION");
        }
      } else if (state.listeningMin > 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
        state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";
        setLine("TOUGH_LOVE");
      } else if (state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
        state.mood = "NEUTRAL";
      } else {
        state.mood = "HAPPY";
        if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
          setLine("NUDGE");
        }
      }
    }

    function renderUI() {
      // streak
      streakCountEl.textContent = state.streak.toString();

      // progress
      const listenPct = Math.min((state.listeningMin / GOAL_LISTEN) * 100, 100);
      const speakPct = Math.min((state.speakingMin / GOAL_SPEAK) * 100, 100);

      listenBarEl.style.width = listenPct + "%";
      speakBarEl.style.width = speakPct + "%";

      listenLabelEl.textContent = `${state.listeningMin} / ${GOAL_LISTEN}m`;
      speakLabelEl.textContent = `${state.speakingMin} / ${GOAL_SPEAK}m`;

      // mood + pulse
      chipMoodEl.textContent = `Mood: ${
        state.mood === "PROUD"
          ? "Proud"
          : state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE"
          ? "Tough love"
          : state.mood === "HAPPY"
          ? "Positive"
          : "Neutral"
      }`;

      chipGoalEl.textContent = `Goal: ${state.dailyGoalMet ? "Complete" : "Not complete"}`;

      if (state.mood === "PROUD") {
        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";
        pulseStatusEl.textContent =
          "You hit your goal. This is what real English training looks like.";
      } else if (state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE") {
        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core slump";
        pulseStatusEl.textContent =
          "Streak broken or no speaking yet. I’m not angry, just honest. Let’s fix it today.";
      } else if (state.mood === "HAPPY") {
        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";
        pulseStatusEl.textContent =
          "Good momentum. Keep stacking small wins – the tiger is waking up.";
      } else {
        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core";
        pulseStatusEl.textContent =
          "We start simple: 45 minutes listening, 15 minutes speaking. I’ll track the truth.";
      }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // EVENT HANDLERS
    // ========================================================================
    btnLogListen.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.listeningMin += 15;
      evaluateGoal();
      saveState();
    });

    btnLogSpeak.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.speakingMin += 5;
      evaluateGoal();
      saveState();
    });

    ctaLogToday.addEventListener("click", () => {
      // Scroll to tracker section
      const section = document.getElementById("section-tracker");
      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      // gentle nudge line
      setLine("NUDGE");
    });

    ctaWhatCan.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const section = document.getElementById("section-capabilities");
      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    });

    // FAQ toggles
    faqItems.forEach(item => {
      const header = item.querySelector(".faq-header");
      header.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");
        faqItems.forEach(i => i.classList.remove("open"));
        if (!isOpen) item.classList.add("open");
      });
    });

    // Listen to state:updated on EventBus (COMET-style pattern)
    EventBus.on("state:updated", renderUI);

    // ========================================================================
    // INIT
    // ========================================================================
    (function init() {
      checkDayRollover();
      renderUI();
      // initial greeting only if no goal yet for today
      if (!state.dailyGoalMet && state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
        setLine("GREETING");
      } else {
        evaluateGoal();
      }
      console.log("NET PET AI V1 :: ONLINE :: PHOENIX × COMET · GOSPEL 444 COMPLIANT");
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>NET PET AI Coach — ULTRA v1.1</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <!-- Canonical fonts -->
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --neon-purple: #a855f7;
      --gold: #f59e0b;
      --deep-dark: #0f0f1a;
      --glass-bg: rgba(15,15,26,0.85);
      --glass-border: rgba(168,85,247,0.38);
      --accent-glow: 0 0 42px 8px #a855f799;
      --text-main: #f9fafb;
      --text-dim: #cfcfe7;
      --radius: 28px;
      --blur: 18px;
      --danger: #ef4444;
      --success: #22c55e;
      --shadow-glass: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.82);
      --transition: 0.15s cubic-bezier(.8,.23,.29,.87);
    }
    html,body {height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;}
    body {
      font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, #a855f733 0%, transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at 88% 90%, #f59e0b33 0%, transparent 65%),
                  var(--deep-dark);
      color: var(--text-main);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    body::after {
      content:"";
      pointer-events:none;
      position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;
      opacity:0.5;
      background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 190deg, #a855f7aa 0deg 12deg, transparent 20deg 36deg, #f59e0baa 36deg 48deg, transparent 60deg 90deg);
      filter:blur(90px);
      mix-blend-mode:screen;
    }
    .app-shell {
      z-index: 1; width:100%; max-width:530px; min-height:97vh;
      display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;
      padding:20px 10px 22px;
      position:relative;
    }
    .app-inner {
      background: var(--glass-bg);
      border-radius: 36px;
      border: 1.6px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur));
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur));
      overflow:hidden;
      width:100%; flex:1; display:flex;flex-direction:column;
      min-height:660px;
    }
    header, .section {padding:18px 22px 10px;}
    .brand {
      font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;
      letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;
      font-size:0.82rem;
      color:var(--gold);
      margin-bottom: .5em;
    }
    .tagline {
      font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);
      font-weight: 400; margin-bottom:1.1em;
    }
    .streak-chip {
      border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold) 25%,rgba(0,0,0,0.63) 95%);
      padding:4px 16px;font-size:.9em;font-weight:600;color:var(--deep-dark);
      margin-left:auto;
      box-shadow:0 0 9px 4px #f59e0b33 inset;
    }
    .star-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--gold);margin-right:6px;}
    .section-label {text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:0.12em;}
    .hero-card {padding:18px 22px 24px;margin-bottom:14px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#a855f71a,#f59e0b17 70%,transparent 100%),rgba(18,16,28,0.86);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0 10px 48px #0f0f1a28;}
    .hero-title {font-size:1.5em;font-weight:800;line-height:1.22;}
    .hero-accent {color:var(--gold);}
    .hero-sub {margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--text-dim);}
    .hero-cta-row{margin-top:14px;display:flex;gap:12px;}
    .btn-pill{
      appearance:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;
      border-radius:999px; padding:11px 26px;font-size:.97em; margin:0 2px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--neon-purple),var(--gold)); color:#0e0213;
      box-shadow:0 7px 21px #a855f799;transition:var(--transition);
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    }
    .btn-pill.secondary{
      background:rgba(249,250,251,0.13); color:var(--text-main);border:1px solid #fff3;
      box-shadow:none;
    } 
    .btn-pill:active {transform:scale(.97);}
    .section{margin-bottom:18px;}
    .pulse-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,.70);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:24px;margin-bottom:12px;}
    .avatar-block{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
    .avatar-ring, .avatar-core{
      border-radius:999px;display:block;box-shadow:0 0 14px #a855f7a6;
    }
    .avatar-ring{
      width:82px;height:82px;border:3.5px solid #a855f788;animation:spin 14s linear infinite;}
    .avatar-core{ width:54px;height:54px;margin-top:-68px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#a855f7 55%,#210837);box-shadow:0 0 34px #a855f7c9;}
    .avatar-core.happy{background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold),#a21caf);box-shadow:0 0 26px #f59e0bcc;}
    .avatar-core.slump{background:radial-gradient(circle,#7f1d1d,#450a0a);box-shadow:0 0 18px #ef4444dd;}
    @keyframes spin{100%{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
    .pulse-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
    .chip{display:inline-block;padding:1.5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#36254b27;color:var(--neon-purple);font-size:.82em;font-weight:600;}
    /* Tracker */
    .tracker-card{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.84);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;}
    .tracker-label{color:var(--text-main);font-size:.82em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:2px;}
    .progress-shell{width:100%;height:9px;background:#a855f70c;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:2.5px;overflow:hidden;}
    .progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:8px;width:0;transition:width 0.33s;}
    .listen-bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a855f7,#b39ddb);}
    .speak-bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#fef08a);}
    /* Capabilities + FAQ + Footer omitted for brevity—see previous section for full styles. */
    /* Add your own responsive and a11y modifiers here as in v1.1 base */
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app-shell">
    <div class="app-inner">
      <header>
        <div class="brand">NET PET AI · ULTRA 1.1</div>
        <div class="tagline">Phoenix × Comet × Claude: Real coach, not an app.</div>
        <div class="streak-chip"><span class="star-dot"></span><span id="streakNum">0</span> days</div>
      </header>
      <div class="section hero-card">
        <div class="section-label">Your AI accountability engine</div>
        <div class="hero-title">
          Build your <span class="hero-accent">English lifestyle</span><br>45·15·EVERY DAY.
        </div>
        <div class="hero-sub">Tracks, coaches, and never lets you stay a mouse.</div>
        <div class="hero-cta-row">
          <button class="btn-pill" id="cta-log">Log today</button>
          <button class="btn-pill secondary" id="cta-more">What can I do?</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="section pulse-card">
        <div class="avatar-block">
          <div class="avatar-ring"></div>
          <div class="avatar-core" id="avatar"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pulse-meta">
          <div id="chipMood" class="chip">Mood: Neutral</div>
          <div id="chipGoal" class="chip" style="background:#f59e0b24;color:var(--gold);">Goal: Not complete</div>
          <div id="pulseStatus" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:1em;">Let’s check: tiger or mouse today?</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="section tracker-card">
        <div class="tracker-label"><span>Listening (Fun Input)</span><span id="lblListen">0/45m</span></div>
        <div class="progress-shell"><div class="progress-fill listen-bar" id="barListen"></div></div>
        <div class="tracker-label"><span>Speaking (Shadow)</span><span id="lblSpeak">0/15m</span></div>
        <div class="progress-shell"><div class="progress-fill speak-bar" id="barSpeak"></div></div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;">
          <button class="btn-pill" style="background:var(--neon-purple);" id="btnListen">+15m Listen</button>
          <button class="btn-pill" style="background:var(--gold);" id="btnSpeak">+5m Speak</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="section" id="aiLines" style="font-style:italic;font-size:1em;padding:8px 0 0 8px; color:var(--text-dim);"></div>
      <div class="section" id="capabilities"></div>
      <div class="section" id="faq"></div>
      <footer class="section" style="text-align:right;font-size:.75em;color:var(--text-dim;">GOSPEL 444 · PHOENIX × COMET · CLAUDE READY</footer>
    </div>
  </div>
  <script>
    // == ULTRA EVENT BUS (AI, AUDIT, UX, AGENT READY)
    const Bus = {subs:{},on(e,f){(this.subs[e]=this.subs[e]||[]).push(f);},emit(e,x){(this.subs[e]||[]).forEach(fn=>fn(x));}};
    // == STATE ENGINE (HASHING, DAY ROLLOVER, STORAGE)
    const BASE = {streak:0,listen:0,speak:0,last:today(),mood:"NEUTRAL",goal:false};
    let state=loadState();

    function today() { return new Date().toLocaleDateString(); }
    function saveState() { localStorage.setItem("npAI",JSON.stringify(state)); localStorage.setItem("npAI_hash",btoa(JSON.stringify(state))); }
    function loadState() {
      try {
        const raw=localStorage.getItem("npAI");
        return raw ? {...BASE, ...JSON.parse(raw)} : {...BASE};
      } catch { return {...BASE}; }
    }
    function checkDay() {
      if(state.last !== today()) {
        state.last = today();
        if(state.goal) { state.streak++; state.mood="HAPPY"; } else { state.streak=0; state.mood="TOUGH"; }
        state.listen = 0; state.speak=0; state.goal=false;
        saveState();
      }
    }
    // == AGENT VOICE LIBRARY
    const LINES = {
      GREETING:[ "Let’s break the grammar cage today.", "Every day is a new upgrade. Ready for 45/15?", "Consistency, not intensity: that’s NET.", "It’s not magic. It’s math. 45 plus 15, every day." ],
      TOUGH: [ "No speaking yet? Cannot get fluent staring at a screen!", "No streak. Nothing changes if nothing changes. Try again now.", "Tiger, not mouse. Prove it next. Click +5.", "No goals, just reasons? Time to move." ],
      HAPPY: [ "Momentum: stacking wins. Let’s go bigger.", "A little English, every day. That’s the path.", "Goal met! Tomorrow, we do it again.", "You’re building a lifestyle, not cramming." ]
    };
    // == RENDER ENGINE
    function render() {
      document.getElementById("streakNum").textContent=state.streak;
      document.getElementById("lblListen").textContent=`${state.listen}/45m`;
      document.getElementById("lblSpeak").textContent=`${state.speak}/15m`;
      document.getElementById("barListen").style.width = Math.min(100,state.listen/45*100)+"%";
      document.getElementById("barSpeak").style.width = Math.min(100,state.speak/15*100)+"%";
      document.getElementById("chipMood").textContent="Mood: "+(state.mood=="HAPPY"?"Happy":state.mood=="TOUGH"?"Tough":"Neutral");
      document.getElementById("chipGoal").textContent="Goal: "+(state.goal?"Complete":"Not complete");
      document.getElementById("avatar").className="avatar-core"+(state.mood=="HAPPY"?" happy":state.mood=="TOUGH"?" slump":"");
      document.getElementById("pulseStatus").textContent=
        state.mood=="TOUGH"?"Slump detected. Tomorrow we break the wall.":
        state.mood=="HAPPY"?"Keep it up: 45/15 = real English.":
        "Small steps. Big wins.";
      // AI lines
      document.getElementById("aiLines").textContent = pickLine(state.mood=="TOUGH"?"TOUGH":state.mood=="HAPPY"?"HAPPY":"GREETING")
    }
    function pickLine(mood) {
      const pool = LINES[mood]||LINES['GREETING'];
      return pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
    }
    // == CONTROLS
    document.getElementById("btnListen").onclick=function(){
      state.listen += 15;
      if(state.listen>45) state.listen=45;
      evaluate(); saveState(); render();
    };
    document.getElementById("btnSpeak").onclick=function(){
      state.speak += 5;
      if(state.speak>15) state.speak=15;
      evaluate(); saveState(); render();
    };
    function evaluate() {
      if(state.listen>=45 && state.speak>=15) { state.goal=true; state.mood="HAPPY"; }
      else if(state.listen>0 && state.speak==0) { state.mood="TOUGH"; }
      else { state.mood="NEUTRAL"; }
    }
    document.getElementById("cta-log").onclick=function(){
      window.scrollTo({top:document.querySelector('.tracker-card').offsetTop-50,left:0,behavior:"smooth"});
    };
    document.getElementById("cta-more").onclick = function(){
      window.scrollTo({top:document.getElementById("capabilities").offsetTop-30,left:0,behavior:"smooth"});
    };

    // == CAPABILITIES + FAQ
    document.getElementById("capabilities").innerHTML =
    `<div class="section-label">What can NET PET do?</div>
      <div style="display:grid;gap:10px;">
        <div class="chip" style="background:#a855f744;color:#f9fafb;">Coach you brutally when you hide</div>
        <div class="chip" style="background:#f59e0b3a;color:#f59e0b;">Lock in your 45·15 streak, day by day</div>
        <div class="chip" style="background:#f59e0b2f;color:#a855f7;">Remind you robot voice ≠ fluent</div>
        <div class="chip" style="background:#a855f71a;color:#f59e0b;">Never lie: only track you, never judge</div>
      </div>`;

    document.getElementById("faq").innerHTML=
    `<div class="section-label">FAQ</div>
      <div class="chip" style="display:block;margin:7px 0;">What if I miss a day? — You snap back to zero. Consistency beats motivation.</div>
      <div class="chip" style="display:block;margin:7px 0;">What gets tracked? — Listening, Speaking, Streak, Mood. Only.</div>
      <div class="chip" style="display:block;margin:7px 0;">Is this a teacher? — No. This is your daily AI coach, not a class.</div>`;

    // == INIT
    checkDay(); evaluate(); saveState(); render();
    Bus.on("state",()=>{saveState();render();});
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>NET PET AI Coach — Phoenix Fusion v2.0</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#0f0f1a" />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --neon-purple: #a855f7;
      --gold: #f59e0b;
      --deep-dark: #0f0f1a;
      --glass-bg: rgba(15,15,26,0.9);
      --glass-border: rgba(168,85,247,0.45);
      --text-main: #f9fafb;
      --text-dim: #c7c7e5;
      --danger: #ef4444;
      --success: #22c55e;
      --radius: 28px;
      --blur: 18px;
      --shadow-glass: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
      --transition: 0.16s cubic-bezier(.8,.23,.29,.87);
    }
    * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }

    body {
      min-height:100vh;
      font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 8% 15%, #a855f733 0%, transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 92% 90%, #f59e0b33 0%, transparent 60%),
        var(--deep-dark);
      color:var(--text-main);
      display:flex;
      align-items:stretch;
      justify-content:center;
      padding:16px 10px;
      overflow-x:hidden;
      position:relative;
    }
    body::after {
      content:"";
      position:fixed;
      inset:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 100%, #a855f744 0%, transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 0%, #f59e0b3a 0%, transparent 60%);
      mix-blend-mode:screen;
      opacity:0.6;
      filter:blur(80px);
    }

    .app-shell {
      z-index:1;
      width:100%;
      max-width:540px;
      min-height:90vh;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
    }
    .app-inner {
      width:100%;
      background:var(--glass-bg);
      border-radius:36px;
      border:1.5px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-glass);
      backdrop-filter:blur(var(--blur));
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--blur));
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      max-height:840px;
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    header, .section { padding:18px 20px 12px; }

    header {
      display:flex;
      align-items:flex-start;
      gap:10px;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .brand {
      font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
      font-size:0.8rem;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:0.16em;
      color:var(--gold);
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .tagline {
      font-size:0.82rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      max-width:220px;
    }
    .streak-chip {
      margin-left:auto;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:6px;
      padding:4px 14px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold) 30%,rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 100%);
      color:#0b0213;
      font-size:0.82rem;
      font-weight:600;
      box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(249,250,251,0.15), 0 0 16px #f59e0b88 inset;
    }
    .streak-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--gold); }

    .section-label {
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-size:0.7rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      letter-spacing:0.14em;
      margin-bottom:6px;
    }

    .hero-card {
      padding:18px 20px 22px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(110deg,#a855f71a,#f59e0b16 65%,transparent 100%),
        rgba(7,7,14,0.9);
      margin:10px 16px 4px;
      border-radius:var(--radius);
      box-shadow:0 14px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size:1.5rem;
      font-weight:800;
      line-height:1.2;
    }
    .hero-accent { color:var(--gold); }
    .hero-sub {
      font-size:0.9rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      margin-top:6px;
    }
    .hero-cta-row {
      margin-top:12px;
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .btn-pill {
      appearance:none;
      border:none;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-family:inherit;
      font-weight:600;
      font-size:0.9rem;
      border-radius:999px;
      padding:10px 20px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a855f7,#f59e0b);
      color:#0c0214;
      box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(168,85,247,0.65);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      transform:translateY(0);
      transition:transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition), opacity var(--transition);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    .btn-pill.secondary {
      background:rgba(249,250,251,0.08);
      color:var(--text-main);
      box-shadow:none;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    }
    .btn-pill:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(0.98); box-shadow:none; }

    /* Pulse + avatar + mode toggle */
    .pulse-row {
      display:flex;
      padding:10px 16px 6px;
      gap:12px;
    }
    .avatar-block {
      flex-shrink:0;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .avatar-toggle-label {
      font-size:0.7rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:0.14em;
    }
    .avatar-ring {
      width:84px; height:84px;
      border-radius:999px;
      border:3.5px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.7);
      box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(168,85,247,0.7);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      position:relative;
      animation:spin 18s linear infinite;
      cursor:pointer;
    }
    .avatar-core {
      width:54px; height:54px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,#a855f7 55%,#1a072a);
      box-shadow:0 0 30px #a855f7;
      transition:all var(--transition);
    }
    .avatar-core.pet {
      background:radial-gradient(circle,#a855f7 55%,#1f102f);
    }
    .avatar-core.prime {
      background:radial-gradient(circle,#f59e0b 25%,#7e22ce 75%);
      box-shadow:0 0 30px #f59e0b;
    }
    .avatar-core.ultra {
      background:conic-gradient(from 180deg,#a855f7,#f59e0b,#a855f7);
      box-shadow:0 0 42px #fbbf24;
    }
    .mode-chip {
      font-size:0.78rem;
      padding:3px 10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      color:var(--text-dim);
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      100% { transform:rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .pulse-meta {
      flex:1;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:4px;
      justify-content:center;
    }
    .chip {
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:6px;
      padding:2px 10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      font-size:0.78rem;
      background:#20132f;
      color:var(--text-dim);
    }

    .tracker-card {
      padding:8px 16px 14px;
    }
    .tracker-label {
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      font-size:0.8rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .progress-shell {
      width:100%;
      height:9px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      overflow:hidden;
      margin-bottom:6px;
    }
    .progress-fill {
      height:100%;
      border-radius:999px;
      width:0;
      transition:width 0.3s ease;
    }
    .bar-listen {
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a855f7,#e9d5ff);
    }
    .bar-speak {
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#fef3c7);
    }

    .daily-buttons {
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      margin-top:8px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .mini-btn {
      flex:1;
      border:none;
      border-radius:999px;
      padding:8px 10px;
      font-size:0.78rem;
      font-weight:600;
      cursor:pointer;
      background:#a855f7;
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(168,85,247,0.6);
      transition:var(--transition);
    }
    .mini-btn.speak {
      background:var(--gold);
      color:#150506;
      box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(245,158,11,0.6);
    }
    .mini-btn:active { transform:scale(0.97); box-shadow:none; }

    /* Momentum / XP */
    .momentum-row {
      display:flex;
      padding:0 16px 12px;
      gap:10px;
    }
    .momentum-meter {
      width:20px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      padding:3px;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      justify-content:flex-end;
      align-items:stretch;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
    }
    .momentum-fill {
      width:100%;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f59e0b,#a855f7);
      height:0;
      transition:height 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow:0 0 20px #a855f7aa;
    }
    .momentum-level-label {
      font-size:0.7rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      text-transform:uppercase;
    }
    .xp-card {
      flex:1;
      border-radius:var(--radius);
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      padding:10px 12px;
    }
    .xp-row {
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      font-size:0.76rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom:2px;
    }

    #aiLines {
      padding:4px 20px 8px;
      font-size:0.9rem;
      font-style:italic;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      min-height:46px;
    }

    /* Capabilities & FAQ pills */
    #capabilities, #faq {
      padding:4px 18px 10px;
    }
    .pill-block {
      display:grid;
      gap:8px;
    }
    .pill {
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:6px;
      padding:6px 10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      font-size:0.78rem;
      background:#a855f722;
      color:var(--text-main);
    }

    footer {
      padding:6px 18px 14px;
      font-size:0.72rem;
      color:var(--text-dim);
      text-align:right;
    }

    @media (max-width:480px) {
      .hero-card { margin-inline:12px; }
      header, .section { padding-inline:14px; }
      .pulse-row, .tracker-card, .momentum-row, #aiLines, #capabilities, #faq, footer { padding-inline:14px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="app-shell">
    <div class="app-inner">
      <header>
        <div>
          <div class="brand">NET PET AI · PHOENIX FUSION v2.0</div>
          <div class="tagline">Daily English coach. Tough love plus real care, zero grammar prison.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="streak-chip">
          <span class="streak-dot"></span>
          <span id="streakNum">0</span> days
        </div>
      </header>

      <section class="hero-card">
        <div class="section-label">Accountability engine</div>
        <div class="hero-title">
          Build your <span class="hero-accent">English lifestyle</span><br>45 · 15 · every day.
        </div>
        <div class="hero-sub">
          Listen like a fan, speak like a tiger. NET PET tracks it. You just show up.
        </div>
        <div class="hero-cta-row">
          <button class="btn-pill" id="ctaLog">Log today</button>
          <button class="btn-pill secondary" id="ctaMore">What can this coach do?</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="pulse-row">
        <div class="avatar-block">
          <div class="avatar-toggle-label">Mode</div>
          <div class="avatar-ring" id="avatarRing">
            <div class="avatar-core pet" id="avatarCore"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mode-chip" id="modeChip">NET PET · Coach</div>
        </div>
        <div class="pulse-meta">
          <div class="chip" id="chipMood">Mood: Neutral</div>
          <div class="chip" id="chipGoal" style="background:#f59e0b24;color:#f59e0b;">Goal: Not complete</div>
          <div id="pulseStatus" style="font-size:0.92rem;margin-top:4px;">
            Let’s check: tiger or mouse today?
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="tracker-card">
        <div class="tracker-label">
          <span>Listening (Fun input)</span>
          <span id="lblListen">0 / 45m</span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-shell">
          <div class="progress-fill bar-listen" id="barListen"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tracker-label">
          <span>Speaking (Shadow / volume)</span>
          <span id="lblSpeak">0 / 15m</span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-shell">
          <div class="progress-fill bar-speak" id="barSpeak"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="daily-buttons">
          <button class="mini-btn" id="btnListen">+15m Listening</button>
          <button class="mini-btn speak" id="btnSpeak">+5m Speaking</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="momentum-row">
        <div class="momentum-meter">
          <div class="momentum-fill" id="momentumFill"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="xp-card">
          <div class="momentum-level-label" id="momentumLabel">Level 1 · Struggling Mouse</div>
          <div class="xp-row"><span>Consistency XP</span><span id="xpConsistency">0</span></div>
          <div class="xp-row"><span>Growth XP</span><span id="xpGrowth">0</span></div>
          <div class="xp-row"><span>Courage XP</span><span id="xpCourage">0</span></div>
          <div class="xp-row"><span>Tiger XP</span><span id="xpTiger">0</span></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="aiLines"></section>
      <section id="capabilities"></section>
      <section id="faq"></section>

      <footer>GOSPEL 444 · PHOENIX ENGINE · CHATTTY PRIME × NET PET</footer>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // ===== EVENT BUS (for future agents / sockets / PWA hooks) =====
    const Bus = {
      subs:{},
      on(ev, fn){ (this.subs[ev] = this.subs[ev] || []).push(fn); },
      emit(ev, payload){ (this.subs[ev] || []).forEach(fn => fn(payload)); }
    };

    // ===== STATE ENGINE =====
    const BASE = {
      streak: 0,
      listen: 0,
      speak: 0,
      last: today(),
      mood: "NEUTRAL", // NEUTRAL | HAPPY | TOUGH
      goal: false,
      xpConsistency: 0,
      xpGrowth: 0,
      xpCourage: 0,
      xpTiger: 0,
      mode: "PET" // PET | PRIME | ULTRA
    };

    function today() {
      return new Date().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    let state = loadState();
    rolloverDay(); // in case they open after midnight

    function loadState() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem("netPet_v2_state");
        if (!raw) return { ...BASE };
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        return { ...BASE, ...parsed };
      } catch {
        return { ...BASE };
      }
    }

    function saveState() {
      localStorage.setItem("netPet_v2_state", JSON.stringify(state));
      // simple hash snapshot for drift detection / debug
      localStorage.setItem("netPet_v2_hash", btoa(JSON.stringify({
        streak: state.streak,
        listen: state.listen,
        speak: state.speak,
        xp: totalXP()
      })));
    }

    function rolloverDay() {
      const todayStr = today();
      if (state.last !== todayStr) {
        // streak logic
        if (state.goal) {
          state.streak += 1;
          state.mood = "HAPPY";
          state.xpConsistency += 10;
        } else {
          state.streak = 0;
          state.mood = "TOUGH";
          state.xpCourage += 5; // you at least opened the app
        }
        state.listen = 0;
        state.speak = 0;
        state.goal = false;
        state.last = todayStr;
        saveState();
      }
    }

    function totalXP() {
      return state.xpConsistency + state.xpGrowth + state.xpCourage + state.xpTiger;
    }

    // ===== VOICE MATRICES =====
    const LINES = {
      PET: {
        GREETING: [
          "Every day is a new chance to build your English lifestyle.",
          "You don’t need perfection. You need today’s 45·15.",
          "Listen like a fan, speak like a tiger.",
          "We’re not studying English. We’re living with it."
        ],
        HAPPY: [
          "Goal done. This is what real learning looks like.",
          "You’re not a robot. You’re a human speaking English.",
          "This is momentum. Don’t break it.",
          "Nice. Tomorrow, same time, same energy."
        ],
        TOUGH: [
          "You can’t learn to swim by looking at the water.",
          "No speaking yet? Your mouth is the muscle. Use it.",
          "One small set now is better than a perfect plan later.",
          "You don’t need motivation. You need 5 nervous minutes."
        ]
      },
      PRIME: {
        GREETING: [
          "Status: online. Your behavior is the only bottleneck.",
          "System check: zero grammar drills required. Only action.",
          "Audit result: today has no log yet. That is a bug.",
          "You are the only person who can fix this sprint."
        ],
        HAPPY: [
          "Daily KPIs met. Confidence curve trending upward.",
          "Streak integrity preserved. Ship again tomorrow.",
          "Data suggests: this version of you speaks more.",
          "You are compounding tiny wins. That’s engineering."
        ],
        TOUGH: [
          "No log. No progress. This is not a training run.",
          "You don’t fix speaking with theory. Only reps.",
          "Your future self is watching this decision.",
          "If you want new output, update your behavior."
        ]
      },
      ULTRA: {
        FUSION: [
          "Seven days of discipline. You’re not learning English, you’re becoming someone new.",
          "This is Phoenix Mode: consistent, dangerous, and fluent.",
          "You broke the cage. Now we build the new world.",
          "From grammar prison to Phoenix. Keep burning forward."
        ]
      }
    };

    function pickLine(type) {
      const mode = state.mode === "ULTRA"
        ? "ULTRA"
        : (state.mode === "PRIME" ? "PRIME" : "PET");

      if (mode === "ULTRA") {
        const pool = LINES.ULTRA.FUSION;
        return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
      }

      const moodKey = type || (state.mood === "HAPPY" ? "HAPPY" : state.mood === "TOUGH" ? "TOUGH" : "GREETING");
      const pool = LINES[mode][moodKey] || LINES[mode].GREETING;
      return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    }

    // ===== XP / LEVEL LOGIC =====
    function levelInfo() {
      const xp = totalXP();
      if (xp >= 400) return { level: 5, label: "Phoenix Mode", momentum: 100 };
      if (xp >= 250) return { level: 4, label: "Tiger Mode", momentum: 80 };
      if (xp >= 120) return { level: 3, label: "Consistent", momentum: 60 };
      if (xp >= 50)  return { level: 2, label: "Waking Up", momentum: 40 };
      return { level: 1, label: "Struggling Mouse", momentum: 20 };
    }

    function maybeUnlockUltra() {
      const info = levelInfo();
      if (info.level >= 5 && state.mode === "PET") {
        state.mode = "ULTRA";
      }
    }

    // ===== EVALUATION =====
    function evaluateProgress(logType) {
      // Basic goal condition
      const beforeGoal = state.goal;
      if (state.listen >= 45 && state.speak >= 15) {
        state.goal = true;
        state.mood = "HAPPY";
        if (!beforeGoal) {
          state.xpGrowth += 10;
          if (logType === "speak") state.xpTiger += 5;
        }
      } else if (state.listen > 0 && state.speak === 0) {
        state.mood = "TOUGH";
      } else {
        state.mood = "NEUTRAL";
      }

      // Courage XP: first speaking log of the day
      if (logType === "speak" && state.speak === 5) {
        state.xpCourage += 3;
      }

      maybeUnlockUltra();
    }

    // ===== RENDER =====
    const els = {
      streakNum: document.getElementById("streakNum"),
      lblListen: document.getElementById("lblListen"),
      lblSpeak: document.getElementById("lblSpeak"),
      barListen: document.getElementById("barListen"),
      barSpeak: document.getElementById("barSpeak"),
      chipMood: document.getElementById("chipMood"),
      chipGoal: document.getElementById("chipGoal"),
      pulseStatus: document.getElementById("pulseStatus"),
      avatarCore: document.getElementById("avatarCore"),
      modeChip: document.getElementById("modeChip"),
      aiLines: document.getElementById("aiLines"),
      momentumFill: document.getElementById("momentumFill"),
      momentumLabel: document.getElementById("momentumLabel"),
      xpConsistency: document.getElementById("xpConsistency"),
      xpGrowth: document.getElementById("xpGrowth"),
      xpCourage: document.getElementById("xpCourage"),
      xpTiger: document.getElementById("xpTiger")
    };

    function render() {
      els.streakNum.textContent = state.streak;
      els.lblListen.textContent = `${state.listen} / 45m`;
      els.lblSpeak.textContent = `${state.speak} / 15m`;

      els.barListen.style.width = Math.min(100, (state.listen / 45) * 100) + "%";
      els.barSpeak.style.width = Math.min(100, (state.speak / 15) * 100) + "%";

      const moodTxt = state.mood === "HAPPY" ? "Happy"
                        : state.mood === "TOUGH" ? "Tough Love"
                        : "Neutral";
      els.chipMood.textContent = `Mood: ${moodTxt}`;
      els.chipGoal.textContent = "Goal: " + (state.goal ? "Complete" : "Not complete");

      // mode chip + avatar
      els.avatarCore.className = "avatar-core " +
        (state.mode === "ULTRA" ? "ultra" : state.mode === "PRIME" ? "prime" : "pet");
      els.modeChip.textContent =
        state.mode === "ULTRA" ? "Phoenix Fusion · Coach+Prime" :
        state.mode === "PRIME" ? "Chatty Prime · Auditor" :
        "NET PET · Coach";

      // pulse text
      if (state.mood === "TOUGH") {
        els.pulseStatus.textContent = "Slump detected. We fix it with one small rep, not guilt.";
      } else if (state.mood === "HAPPY") {
        els.pulseStatus.textContent = "Goal hit. This is how confidence is built, not wished for.";
      } else {
        els.pulseStatus.textContent = "Tiny daily actions. Big long-term upgrades.";
      }

      // XP + level
      const info = levelInfo();
      els.momentumFill.style.height = info.momentum + "%";
      els.momentumLabel.textContent = `Level ${info.level} · ${info.label}`;
      els.xpConsistency.textContent = state.xpConsistency;
      els.xpGrowth.textContent = state.xpGrowth;
      els.xpCourage.textContent = state.xpCourage;
      els.xpTiger.textContent = state.xpTiger;

      els.aiLines.textContent = pickLine();
    }

    // ===== CAPABILITIES & FAQ STATIC RENDER =====
    function renderStaticSections() {
      const cap = document.getElementById("capabilities");
      cap.innerHTML = `
        <div class="section-label">What can this coach do?</div>
        <div class="pill-block">
          <div class="pill">🐯 Push your comfort zone when you hide behind silence.</div>
          <div class="pill">📊 Track your 45·15 habit with streaks, XP, and momentum.</div>
          <div class="pill">🧠 Switch voices: soft human coach or strict auditor.</div>
          <div class="pill">🔥 Unlock Phoenix Fusion when you prove you're consistent.</div>
        </div>
      `;
      const faq = document.getElementById("faq");
      faq.innerHTML = `
        <div class="section-label">FAQ</div>
        <div class="pill">❓ What if I miss a day? — Your streak resets. No drama. Just start again today.</div>
        <div class="pill">❓ Do I need grammar books? — No. Listen, mimic, and speak. Grammar joins later.</div>
        <div class="pill">❓ Is this a teacher? — This is your daily English coach. Human classes are extra firepower.</div>
      `;
    }

    // ===== EVENT LISTENERS =====
    document.getElementById("btnListen").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.listen = Math.min(45, state.listen + 15);
      evaluateProgress("listen");
      saveState();
      render();
      Bus.emit("log", { type:"listen", state:{...state} });
    });

    document.getElementById("btnSpeak").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.speak = Math.min(15, state.speak + 5);
      evaluateProgress("speak");
      saveState();
      render();
      Bus.emit("log", { type:"speak", state:{...state} });
    });

    document.getElementById("ctaLog").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = document.querySelector(".tracker-card");
      if (!target) return;
      window.scrollTo({ top: target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 50, behavior: "smooth" });
    });

    document.getElementById("ctaMore").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = document.getElementById("capabilities");
      window.scrollTo({ top: target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 40, behavior: "smooth" });
    });

    document.getElementById("avatarRing").addEventListener("click", () => {
      // cycle modes: PET -> PRIME -> ULTRA (if unlocked) -> PET ...
      const info = levelInfo();
      const ultraUnlocked = info.level >= 5;
      if (state.mode === "PET") {
        state.mode = "PRIME";
      } else if (state.mode === "PRIME") {
        state.mode = ultraUnlocked ? "ULTRA" : "PET";
      } else {
        state.mode = "PET";
      }
      saveState();
      render();
    });

    // Example Bus listener (extendable)
    Bus.on("log", payload => {
      // future: sync to backend, show confetti, etc.
      // console.log("NET PET log event:", payload);
    });

    // ===== INIT =====
    renderStaticSections();
    saveState();
    render();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

3️⃣ PWA bits — manifest.json + service-worker.js
manifest.json
{
  "name": "NET PET AI Coach — Phoenix Fusion",
  "short_name": "NET PET",
  "start_url": "./index.html",
  "display": "standalone",
  "background_color": "#0f0f1a",
  "theme_color": "#0f0f1a",
  "icons": [
    {
      "src": "icon-192.png",
      "sizes": "192x192",
      "type": "image/png"
    },

service-worker.js
const CACHE_NAME = "net-pet-v2-cache-v1";
const ASSETS = [
  "./",
  "./index.html",
  "./styles.css",
  "./app.js",
  "./manifest.json"
];

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.addAll(ASSETS))
  );
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((keys) =>
      Promise.all(
        keys
          .filter((key) => key !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map((key) => caches.delete(key))
      )
    )
  );
});

self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(event.request).then((resp) => {
      return resp || fetch(event.request);
    })
  );
});
Then, in app.js (or a tiny extra script), register the worker:

if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("./service-worker.js").catch(() => {});
  });
}

// --- Security & Persistence Functions (P0/P1 Hardening) ---

// MANDATE: P1 Input Sanitation. Blocks script and tag injection.
function sanitizeInput(input) {
  // Use textContent property of a temporary element to safely escape HTML.
  const temp = document.createElement('div');
  temp.textContent = input;
  return temp.innerHTML; // This is safe because user-provided content is already escaped.
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Saves state (simulating hashState_SHA256 verification).
function saveState() {
  try {
    const stateToSave = JSON.stringify(state);
    // In full Phoenix, this would be encrypted and hashed before setting.
    localStorage.setItem('netAppState', stateToSave); 
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("PHOENIX AUDIT: Could not save state to local storage.", e);
  }
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Loads state on initialization.
function loadState() {
  try {
    const savedState = localStorage.getItem('netAppState');
    if (savedState) {
      const parsedState = JSON.parse(savedState);
      // Merge saved properties back into initial state
      Object.assign(state, parsedState);
      renderAll(); // Rerender UI based on loaded state
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("PHOENIX AUDIT: Corrupted state found. Starting new session.");
  }
}

// --- Hardened Lock Session Function ---
function lockSession() {
  if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";
    return;
  }
  const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
  
  // *** HARDENING: SANITIZE USER INPUT BEFORE STORING ***
  const sanitizedPlan = sanitizeInput(sessionNotesEl.value);

  if (!sanitizedPlan) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";
    return;
  }

  state.lockedSession = {
    buddyId: buddy.id,
    goal: sessionGoalEl.value,
    length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),
    topic: sessionTopicEl.value,
    notes: sanitizedPlan // Store the sanitized data
  };

  // *** PERSISTENCE MANDATE: SAVE STATE AFTER CRITICAL ACTION ***
  saveState(); 

  sessionStatusLine.textContent =
    "Session locked with " + buddy.name +
    " for " + state.lockedSession.length +
    " minutes. The only job now: show up.";
}

// --- Modified Initializer and Renders ---
function renderAll() {
  renderMetrics();
  renderBuddyList();
  setActiveView(state.activeView);
}

// --- INITIALIZATION ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  loadState(); // Load state on DOM ready
  renderAll(); // Initial render based on loaded or default state

  // Attach event listeners after loading state and rendering
  navButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const view = e.currentTarget.dataset.view;
      if (view) setActiveView(view);
    });
  });

  btnFillTemplate.addEventListener("click", autoFillSessionIdea);
  // Redefine lockSession listener to use the hardened version
  btnLockSession.addEventListener("click", lockSession); 
});

function todayString() {
  return new Date().toDateString();
}

export function loadPetState(storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    const raw = storage.getItem("netPetV1State");
    return raw ? { ...DEFAULT_PET_STATE, ...JSON.parse(raw) } : { ...DEFAULT_PET_STATE };
  } catch {
    return { ...DEFAULT_PET_STATE };
  }
}

export function savePetState(state, storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    storage.setItem("netPetV1State", JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  EventBus.emit("pet:state", { ...state });
}

export function checkPetDayRollover(state) {
  const today = todayString();
  if (state.lastLogin !== today) {
    if (state.dailyGoalMet) {
      state.streak += 1;
      state.mood = "HAPPY";
    } else {
      state.streak = 0;
      state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";
    }
    state.listeningMin = 0;
    state.speakingMin = 0;
    state.dailyGoalMet = false;
    state.lastLogin = today;
  }
}

export function evaluatePetGoal(state) {
  const { listen, speak } = PET_GOAL;
  if (state.listeningMin >= listen && state.speakingMin >= speak) {
    if (!state.dailyGoalMet) {
      state.dailyGoalMet = true;
      state.mood = "PROUD";
      return "CELEBRATION";
    }
  } else if (state.listeningMin > 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
    state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";
    return "TOUGH_LOVE";
  } else if (state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
    state.mood = "NEUTRAL";
    return "GREETING";
  } else {
    state.mood = "HAPPY";
    return "NUDGE";
  }
  return null;
}

export function pickPetLine(category) {
  const pool = PET_VOICE[category];
  if (!pool || !pool.length) return "";
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}

    totalSessions: 0,
    listenMinutes: 0,
    speakMinutes: 0,
  },
};

export function lockBuddySession(state, buddyId, sessionData) {
  const buddy = state.buddies.find((b) => b.id === buddyId);
  if (!buddy) throw new Error("Buddy not found");
  state.selectedBuddyId = buddyId;
  state.lockedSession = {
    buddyId,
    ...sessionData,
    ts: Date.now(),
  };
  state.metrics.totalSessions += 1;
  return state.lockedSession;
}

// ==========================
// 5. ULTRA SAIYAN UTILITIES
// ==========================
export const StringUtils = {
  capitalize: (str) => str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1),
  reverse: (str) => [...str].reverse().join(""),
  count: (str, sub) => str.split(sub).length - 1,
  stripSpaces: (str) => str.replace(/\s+/g, ""),
  toCamel: (str) => str.replace(/[-_ ]+(\w)/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase()),
  toKebab: (s) => s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "-"),
  toSnake: (s) => s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "_"),
  titleCase: (str) => str.split(" ").map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(" "),
  truncate: (s, n) => (s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n - 1) + "…" : s),
  slugify: (s) =>
    s
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
      .trim()
      .replace(/[\s_-]+/g, "-"),
};

// ==========================
// 6. HANDOFF BOOTSTRAP HOOK
// ==========================

export function bootstrapNetPetUI({
  getState = loadPetState,
  saveStateFn = savePetState,
  onRender,
} = {}) {
  let state = getState();

  function update() {
    checkPetDayRollover(state);
    const category = evaluatePetGoal(state);
    if (category) {
      const line = pickPetLine(category);
      EventBus.emit("pet:line", { category, line });
    }
    saveStateFn(state);
    if (onRender) onRender(state);
  }

  EventBus.on("pet:incrementListen", (minutes = 15) => {
    state.listeningMin += minutes;
    update();
  });

  EventBus.on("pet:incrementSpeak", (minutes = 5) => {
    state.speakingMin += minutes;
    update();
  });

  // initial render
  update();
  return state;
}

const PET_BASE = {

  mood: "NEUTRAL",
  dailyGoalMet: false
};

function petToday() {
  return new Date().toDateString();
}

function petLoadState(storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    const raw = storage.getItem("netPetState");
    return raw ? { ...PET_BASE, ...JSON.parse(raw) } : { ...PET_BASE };

    return { ...PET_BASE };
  }

function petSaveState(state, storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    storage.setItem("netPetState", JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function petCheckRollover(state) {
  if (state.lastLogin !== petToday()) {
    state.lastLogin = petToday();
    if (state.dailyGoalMet) {

      state.mood = "HAPPY";
    } else {

      petState.xp.consistency += 5;

    return "NUDGE"; // small extra push or soft congrats

***

## Change roadmap for Vietnam 2024–2025

### Keep core (don’t touch the backbone)

- **Confidence-first, speaking-heavy focus.** Speaking anxiety and fear of negative evaluation are central blockers for Vietnamese adults; a product that targets confidence and real speaking time is directly aligned with the pain. [5][6][4]
- **Habit spine (45/15 + daily micro-learning).** Blended, flexible, personalized learning with micro-doses and data is exactly where Vietnam’s L&D and corporate blended-learning markets are moving. [2][1][12]
- **Gamification, but adult-flavored.** Streaks, progress bars, simple rewards and visible ROI are strongly supported for workplace training; over 80% of employees report higher motivation in gamified environments. [7][9]

### Modify wording / framing (same idea, different skin)

- Rename external promise from “Mouse → Tiger” to something status-safe for LinkedIn and HR:
  - “Executive English Presence for Vietnamese Professionals.”
  - “Operator Mode: Confident English in Real Work Situations.”  
  Keep “Tiger Voice” as an internal challenge name or campaign, not the brand’s main elevator pitch. [2][3]
- Shift tough-love copy from sarcasm to **respectful directness**:
  - From “You don’t have an English problem, you have a confidence problem”  
  - To “You already know the grammar; what’s missing is safe, structured speaking time.”  
  This keeps the core insight but removes implied blame, which matters in a high face-saving culture. [5][13]
- NET PET:  
  - Visuals: flatter, more minimal creature or abstract “energy orb”, muted colors, no big eyes; closer to a coaching avatar than a cartoon. [9][8]
  - Copy: “NET Coach” that “evolves as your performance grows” rather than “pet that gets angry if you skip.”

### A/B test soon (you genuinely don’t know until the market hits it)

- **Headline variants in paid ads / landing pages** targeting 25–40 y/o professionals:
  - A: “From Mouse Voice to Tiger Voice in English Meetings.”
  - B: “Speak with Executive-Level English Confidence in Meetings.”
  - C: “Stop Freezing in English. Start Leading the Conversation.”  
  Success metric: lead submissions and booked calls. Hypothesis from current L&D trends: B/C will outperform A among older and more senior users; A may work among younger, more meme-literate tech staff. [2][14][4]
- **Visual theme for HR decks and website corporate pages:**
  - Dark-neon vs neutral SaaS vs hybrid (light with subtle purple/gold).  
  Metric: reply rate to outbound decks, close rate on HR pitches. Expect neutral/hybrid to win with HR in most sectors. [2][1][12]
- **Gamification depth:**
  - Version 1: very light (streak + progress bar + milestones).  
  - Version 2: adds subtle avatar evolution and “seasons” (projects/quests).  
  Track retention and self-reported “seriousness” vs “toy feeling”. Research suggests light, transparent mechanics outperform heavy narrative for adults. [9][10][7]

### Kill or phase out

- **“Mouse Voice” as a public label** for users. It directly overlaps with fear-of-judgment, which the Vietnamese speaking-anxiety literature highlights as the main pain point. [5][6][4]
- **Childish boss-battle / loot language** in any HR or LinkedIn-facing copy. You can keep the progression logic internally; externally, translate to “milestones,” “levels,” “certificates,” and “reports.” [2][1]
- **Overly edgy villain imagery (“prison”, “enemy”)** in B2B decks. L&D trends in Vietnam and SEA emphasize psychological safety, growth mindset and positive framing; heavy negative metaphors can feel outdated or misaligned with “people-first” HR narratives. [2][11]

***

Net: the **philosophy is solid**, the **mechanics are mostly right**, and the **flavor layer is where the cringe risk lives**. Strip childish / shame‑adjacent metaphors from anything HR can see, keep the “Ultra Saiyan” energy inside the learner experience and performance metrics, and you have something that can read as a serious performance tool rather than a toy.
